title: Unfair grading in mid-semester exam
description: My mid-semester exam paper was graded incorrectly. I scored full marks in three questions but was given partial credit without any explanation. I requested a re-evaluation but the professor ignored my request for two weeks.

title: Teacher absent for entire month
description: Our Data Structures professor has been absent for the entire month of October. No substitute has been arranged and the syllabus is falling behind severely affecting our exam preparation.

title: Practical marks not updated
description: My practical examination marks from last semester have still not been updated on the university portal even after three months. This is affecting my CGPA calculation and scholarship eligibility.

title: Biased internal assessment
description: The internal assessment marks for my section appear to be biased. Students who attend extra coaching with the same professor are consistently scoring higher than those who do not.

title: Syllabus not completed before exams
description: The professor teaching Operating Systems did not complete the syllabus before the end-semester examination. More than four units were left uncovered leaving students underprepared.

title: Wrong question paper distributed
description: During the scheduled examination for Software Engineering the wrong question paper was distributed to our hall. The examination had to be cancelled causing unnecessary stress to all students.

title: Attendance shortage due to professor error
description: My attendance has been marked short due to an administrative error by the professor. I have all class notes and timestamps proving I was present but the correction request has been denied.

title: Project guide not available
description: My final year project guide has not responded to emails or meeting requests for over six weeks. This is significantly delaying my project progress and my submission deadline is approaching.

title: Re-evaluation result not communicated
description: I applied for re-evaluation of my third-semester end-term examination three months ago. I have not received any result or acknowledgment and the university office gives no timeline.

title: Discriminatory grading based on attendance
description: Students who missed classes due to medical emergencies are being penalized in internal marks disproportionately compared to students with similar attendance for other reasons.

title: Broken projector in classroom
description: The projector in Room 204 has been non-functional for the past three weeks. Multiple complaints have been filed with the maintenance department but no repair has been done.

title: No drinking water on third floor
description: The water cooler on the third floor of the main academic block has been broken for two months. Students have to walk to the ground floor for water disrupting classes.

title: Waterlogging in laboratory corridor
description: The corridor outside the chemistry laboratory floods every time it rains due to a blocked drain. This creates a safety hazard and has caused two students to slip and injure themselves.

title: Electrical short circuit in classroom
description: There was a short circuit in classroom 301 last week that caused sparks near the seating area. Students were evacuated but the room has been in use again without any electrical inspection.

title: Wi-Fi not working in hostel block C
description: The Wi-Fi in hostel Block C has been non-functional for ten days. This affects online classes assignment submissions and self-study for over two hundred residents.

title: Library roof leaking during monsoon
description: The library roof has been leaking since the beginning of the monsoon season. Books and computers near the windows have been damaged and no repair work has been initiated.

title: Broken benches in seminar hall
description: Most of the benches in the seminar hall are broken or unstable. During a recent guest lecture two students fell when a bench collapsed causing minor injuries.

title: No power backup in examination hall
description: During the end-semester examination the power went out and there was no backup generator available. Students had to sit in the dark for forty-five minutes affecting the entire batch.

title: Lift not working in academic block
description: The elevator in the academic block has been out of service for three weeks. Students with physical disabilities and those carrying heavy laboratory equipment are severely inconvenienced.

title: Computer lab PCs not maintained
description: More than half the computers in Computer Lab 2 are either not booting or have outdated software. Students scheduled for practical examinations have raised this issue multiple times with no resolution.

title: Senior students ragging freshers
description: Several senior students have been verbally harassing and intimidating first-year students in the hostel common room after 10 PM. Three freshers reported being forced to perform demeaning tasks.

title: Professor making inappropriate comments
description: A faculty member has been making personal remarks about students' appearances and family backgrounds during lectures. Multiple students in the class have been uncomfortable but fear retaliation.

title: Gender-based discrimination in lab groups
description: The laboratory instructor assigns group work by gender consistently placing female students in less important roles. When students objected they were told to comply or face attendance deductions.

title: Cyberbullying in class WhatsApp group
description: A group of students has been sharing edited photographs and derogatory messages targeting a female student in the class WhatsApp group. The posts have been screenshotted and are available as evidence.

title: Caste-based discrimination in hostel
description: A student from a scheduled caste background has been denied entry to shared hostel spaces by other students and has received caste-based slurs. The hostel warden has not taken any action.

title: Faculty threatening marks for personal reasons
description: A professor threatened to deduct internal marks from a student who reported the professor's delayed syllabus completion. The threat was made in front of the class and witnessed by multiple students.

title: Student being excluded from group projects
description: A student with a physical disability is being systematically excluded from group projects and study groups. When raised with the class coordinator the issue was dismissed as a personal matter.

title: Religious discrimination in assignment evaluation
description: A student belonging to a minority religious group has noticed a consistent pattern of lower evaluation scores compared to peers submitting work of equal quality. The pattern spans three semesters.

title: Threatening behaviour near campus gate
description: A group of outsiders has been gathering near the campus gate and verbally harassing female students when they leave in the evening. Security guards are aware but have not intervened effectively.

title: Student threatened for filing complaint
description: After filing a complaint against a senior student the complainant received threatening messages on Instagram warning them to withdraw the complaint or face consequences.

title: Scholarship amount not credited
description: My merit scholarship for the academic year was approved in August but the amount has not been credited to my bank account. I have followed up with the accounts office five times with no resolution.

title: Duplicate fee charged for re-admission
description: I was charged the full admission fee again when continuing in the second year despite having already paid it. The accounts office acknowledged the error but has not refunded the excess amount.

title: Examination fee deducted twice
description: My bank account was debited twice for the examination fee. The bank has confirmed the double transaction but the university accounts office has not processed the refund for four months.

title: Fee receipt not issued
description: After paying the tuition fee for this semester I was not provided a fee receipt. When I asked for one the accounts office said the system was down and never followed up.

title: Government fee waiver not applied
description: I am eligible for a state government fee waiver under the OBC category. All documents were submitted at the time of admission but the waiver has not been applied and I have been charged full fees.

title: Library fine charged incorrectly
description: A library fine of Rs 800 was charged to my student account for books I returned on time. I have the return receipt but the library system shows the books as overdue.

title: Hostel fee increase without notice
description: The hostel fee was increased by 30% at the start of this semester with no prior notice or communication. Students were informed only when they came to pay and were given no explanation.

title: Transport fee charged for non-users
description: Students who do not use the college bus facility are being charged a transport fee at the time of admission. Multiple requests to remove this charge have been ignored.

title: Refund not processed after withdrawal
description: A student who withdrew from the course within the refund period has not received their tuition refund after five months. The accounts office provides conflicting information on each visit.

title: Caution deposit not returned after graduation
description: My caution deposit paid at the time of admission has not been returned six months after graduation. The administration office keeps asking for additional documents that were already submitted.

title: Degree certificate not issued after one year
description: I completed my graduation examination over a year ago. My degree certificate has still not been issued despite multiple follow-ups. I have been unable to apply for jobs or higher studies because of this.

title: Migration certificate delayed
description: I applied for a migration certificate two months ago to pursue higher studies at another university. The application has been acknowledged but the certificate has not been issued.

title: Incorrect name on marksheet
description: My name is spelled incorrectly on my second-semester marksheet. The correction request was submitted six months ago with all supporting documents but the corrected marksheet has not been issued.

title: Enrollment number not generated
description: My enrollment number was not generated at the start of the academic year despite completing all admission formalities. This has prevented me from registering for examinations.

title: College leaving certificate not provided
description: I am relocating and need a college leaving certificate to seek admission elsewhere. Despite multiple applications the administration office has not issued this document for three months.

title: Identity card not issued to new student
description: I have been studying at this institution for four months and my student identity card has still not been issued. This is required for library access laboratory entry and examination hall entry.

title: Timetable not communicated on time
description: The examination timetable for the upcoming end-semester exams was communicated only three days before the first paper. Students had inadequate time to prepare especially for practical examinations.

title: Wrong course registered
description: The administration office registered me for the wrong elective course. When I raised this the office said the correction would incur a penalty fee which I should not be required to pay.

title: Transfer certificate withheld
description: My transfer certificate is being withheld by the administration office because of a pending dues notice that I have already cleared. I have the payment receipt but the certificate is still not being issued.

title: No response to RTI application
description: I filed an RTI application regarding my examination result discrepancy over three months ago. Neither an acknowledgment nor a response has been provided within the legally mandated thirty-day period.

title: Hostel room allocated far from amenities
description: I was allocated a room in the farthest block of the hostel despite having a medical condition that requires regular access to the medical room. My request for a room change has been ignored for two months.

title: Unhygienic food served in hostel mess
description: The food served in the hostel mess is frequently undercooked and stored improperly. Several students have reported stomach infections in the past two weeks that are likely linked to the food quality.

title: Warden behaving inappropriately with students
description: The hostel warden has been making derogatory remarks to students about their study habits and lifestyle. The warden has also entered rooms without notice or permission on multiple occasions.

title: No hot water supply in hostel
description: The hostel has had no hot water supply for three weeks. This is a major concern particularly for students with health conditions and during the winter months when cold water is dangerous.

title: Rats and insects in hostel kitchen
description: The hostel kitchen area has a severe rat and cockroach infestation. Students who eat in the mess have raised this issue but the administration has not arranged for pest control.

title: Hostel curfew unreasonably strict
description: The hostel curfew of 7 PM is unreasonably strict and does not account for students with evening lab sessions library hours or college events that regularly run beyond that time.

title: Hostel room not cleaned for months
description: The common bathrooms and corridors in Block D have not been cleaned properly for over two months. The cleaning staff is present but does minimal work and there is no supervisor checking quality.

title: Broken locks on hostel rooms
description: The locks on three rooms in Block B are broken and cannot be secured properly. Students in these rooms have raised safety concerns but maintenance has not addressed the issue after three weeks.

title: No study room in hostel
description: The hostel has no dedicated study room or quiet area. Students are expected to study only in their rooms which are often noisy due to shared accommodation with no noise regulations enforced.

title: Hostel allocation not as promised
description: During admission I was assured of a single occupancy room due to a medical condition but was placed in a four-person room. The hostel warden says no single rooms are available despite the prospectus stating otherwise.

title: College bus consistently late
description: The college bus serving the eastern route has been arriving 30 to 45 minutes late every day for the past month. This causes students to miss the first period regularly.

title: Bus driver behaving rashly
description: The driver of Bus Route 4 drives at unsafe speeds on the highway and frequently uses a mobile phone while driving. Several students have raised this with the transport office but no action has been taken.

title: Route changed without notice
description: The college bus route was changed without any prior notification to students. Several students missed the bus for three consecutive days before the change was officially communicated.

title: Overcrowding in college bus
description: The college bus on Route 7 carries nearly double its seating capacity every morning. Students are standing in the aisle which is both unsafe and extremely uncomfortable for a 45-minute journey.

title: Transport fee collected but no bus facility
description: Students living in the northern zone were charged a transport fee but no bus service has been provided for that area. Three months of follow-up with the transport office has yielded no result.

title: Bus not available for late evening classes
description: Students who have laboratory or elective sessions that end after 7 PM have no college bus facility to return home. This particularly affects female students who are then forced to arrange expensive private transport.

title: Bus break-down with no replacement
description: The college bus broke down mid-route last Tuesday leaving forty students stranded on the highway for two hours. The transport office did not send a replacement vehicle and was unresponsive to calls.

title: AC not working in college bus
description: The air conditioning in Bus Route 2 has not been working for over a month. During peak summer temperatures the bus interior reaches dangerous heat levels particularly for morning pick-ups.

title: No bus for industrial visit
description: The college arranged an industrial visit but did not provide transportation. Students were told to arrange their own transport at the last minute causing significant inconvenience and additional expense.

title: Bus pass not issued despite payment
description: I paid the bus fee in June but my bus pass has still not been issued. The transport office says the passes are in process but cannot give a timeline and I have been paying auto fare every day.

title: Required book not available in library
description: The textbook recommended for the Database Management Systems course has been unavailable in the library for the entire semester. Only one copy exists for a class of one hundred and twenty students.

title: Library fine imposed for returned books
description: I was charged a fine for three books that I returned within the borrowing period. I have the receipt showing the return date but the library system shows them as overdue and the librarian refuses to correct it.

title: Library timings too restrictive
description: The library closes at 5 PM on weekdays and remains closed on weekends. Students who have classes or laboratory sessions during library hours cannot access books and reference material.

title: Online library access not working
description: My login credentials for the online library portal and NPTEL access have not worked since the start of the semester. Multiple emails to the library and IT desk have gone unanswered.

title: Damaged books not replaced
description: Multiple textbooks in the library reference section are damaged with torn pages water stains and missing chapters. These have been reported to the librarian but have not been replaced or repaired.

title: Library staff behaving rudely
description: The library staff routinely behave in a dismissive and rude manner toward students asking for assistance. A student was spoken to harshly in front of others for requesting a book that was not on the shelf.

title: No silence maintained in library
description: The library has become a socializing space with no silence rules being enforced. Staff members themselves engage in loud conversations making it impossible to study during examination preparation periods.

title: Reference books restricted to inside use only
description: Several key reference books required for final-year projects cannot be borrowed and must be used inside the library. Since the library closes early most students cannot access these books adequately.

title: Journal subscriptions expired
description: The library's subscriptions to several research journals including IEEE and Elsevier appear to have expired. Students attempting to access papers for their dissertations are being denied access.

title: No printing facility near library
description: The library has no printing or photocopying facility. Students who need to print reference materials must walk to a shop outside the campus which is not always accessible during college hours.

title: Laboratory equipment not calibrated
description: The measuring instruments in the Physics laboratory have not been calibrated this academic year. Experiment results are therefore inaccurate and students are recording wrong observations which affects marks.

title: Chemicals stored improperly
description: Several chemicals in the Chemistry laboratory are stored without proper labels or safety data sheets. The chemicals are within reach of students and no safety training has been provided this semester.

title: No safety equipment in lab
description: Students working in the electronics laboratory are not provided with safety gloves or goggles. When requested the lab assistant said the equipment was not available and students should bring their own.

title: Lab attendance not recorded correctly
description: My laboratory attendance for the third semester is incorrectly recorded. I am shown as absent for sessions I attended and this has led to a shortage that will result in my being barred from the practical examination.

title: Outdated lab software
description: The software installed in the Computer Science laboratory is ten years old and does not support the programs required by the current syllabus. Students are unable to complete assigned practical tasks.

title: Laboratory sessions cancelled frequently
description: The laboratory sessions for the Electronics and Communication course have been cancelled six times this semester without rescheduling. This means students have completed less than half the required practical hours.

title: No first aid kit in laboratory
description: None of the science laboratories have a first-aid kit. When a student was injured by broken glassware last week there was no immediate medical aid available on the floor.

title: Unfair lab marks allocation
description: The laboratory marks for my section appear to be allocated based on personal familiarity with the lab instructor rather than on the quality of work. Students who spend time with the instructor outside class consistently score higher.

title: Lab manual not provided
description: The laboratory manual for the Microprocessors course was not distributed at the start of the semester. Students have had to conduct experiments without written instructions leading to inconsistent results.

title: Broken oscilloscopes in electronics lab
description: Seven out of twelve oscilloscopes in the Electronics laboratory are not functioning. Students have to share one working instrument among four people making it impossible to complete experiments in the allocated time.

title: No career guidance cell
description: The college has no functional career guidance or placement cell. Students in final year have no support for resume preparation interview training or connecting with recruiters.

title: Sports equipment not available
description: The sports room has not been stocked with equipment for over a year. Students who wish to participate in physical activities or prepare for inter-college tournaments have no facility to practice.

title: Mental health support not available
description: There is no counsellor or mental health professional available on campus. Several students going through academic and personal difficulties have no one to turn to within the institution.

title: Anti-ragging committee not active
description: The anti-ragging committee has no visible presence on campus. The complaint box in the hostel has not been opened or checked in months and students are unaware of how to report incidents.

title: No grievance redressal mechanism visible
description: Students are not informed about the grievance redressal process at the time of admission. There are no posters notices or orientations explaining how to raise complaints.

title: Canteen food quality very poor
description: The canteen food is consistently undercooked stale and overpriced. Students who rely on the canteen for meals are left with poor nutritional options and no alternative on campus.

title: No disabled-friendly infrastructure
description: The campus has no ramps wheelchair access or disabled-friendly washrooms. A student using a wheelchair is unable to access several academic buildings and the library independently.

title: Delay in issuing hall tickets
description: Hall tickets for the end-semester examination were issued only one day before the first exam. Students were unable to verify information and correct errors in time causing exam-day confusion.

title: No notice board updates
description: The notice board outside the administrative office has not been updated in four months. Students miss important circulars and deadlines because information is only posted physically without any digital backup.

title: Parking area insufficient
description: The college parking area is grossly insufficient for the number of students and staff. Students park on the road outside causing traffic disruption and there have been two vehicle theft incidents.

title: Professor not teaching properly
description: The professor just reads from slides without any explanation. Students are unable to understand the concepts.

title: Internal marks not displayed
description: Our internal assessment marks have not been displayed on the notice board or portal as required by university rules.

title: Guest lecturer did not attend
description: The guest lecturer scheduled for the seminar did not show up. No replacement or rescheduling has been communicated.

title: Plagiarism accusation without proof
description: A student was accused of plagiarism in their dissertation without being shown any specific evidence. The accusation has affected their grade and no formal hearing was held.

title: Exam paper leaked before exam
description: There are credible reports that the question paper for the upcoming unit test was shared with certain students in advance by a faculty member.

title: No feedback on assignments
description: Assignments submitted in the first month of the semester have still not been returned or graded. Students have no idea where they stand on internal assessment.

title: Wrong marks entered in university portal
description: My end-semester examination marks were entered incorrectly in the university portal. The correct answer scripts are available but the portal still shows wrong marks.

title: Elective course cancelled last minute
description: The elective course I had registered for was cancelled two weeks after the semester started with no alternative offered. I was automatically assigned a course I had not chosen.

title: Lab record not checked for months
description: Laboratory records submitted three months ago have not been checked or returned. Students cannot prepare for practicals without feedback on previous work.

title: Insufficient lecture hours per week
description: The prescribed lecture hours per week for the core engineering subject are not being followed. Only two hours per week are being conducted against the required four.

title: Broken tiles creating tripping hazard
description: The floor tiles near the entrance of Block B are broken and create a tripping hazard. Two students have already fallen. The maintenance department was informed two weeks ago with no action taken.

title: No emergency exits marked
description: The academic building has no clearly marked emergency exits and no fire evacuation plan displayed. This is a serious safety violation that has been unaddressed for the entire academic year.

title: Canteen ceiling leaking
description: The canteen ceiling has been leaking during rains and water drips onto the food serving area. This is a hygiene and safety concern that has been raised multiple times.

title: Generator not working during load shedding
description: During scheduled load shedding the college generator does not activate for the laboratory block. Students are left in the dark during practicals that involve sensitive equipment.

title: Poor ventilation in classrooms
description: The classrooms in the old academic block have no windows that open and the fans are insufficient. During summer months the temperature becomes unbearable and affects concentration.

title: Inadequate lighting in parking area
description: The parking area behind the hostel is completely dark at night. Students returning from evening activities feel unsafe and there have been reports of theft in this area.

title: Water supply cut for three days
description: The water supply to the hostel and academic block was cut for three days without any advance notice or alternative arrangement. Students could not wash cook or clean.

title: Sewage overflow near laboratory block
description: A sewage line overflow near the laboratory block has created an extremely unhygienic environment. The smell is unbearable and there is a risk of disease. This has been reported and ignored for a week.

title: Dustbins not emptied regularly
description: The dustbins in the corridors and classrooms are not emptied regularly leading to overflowing trash and foul odors. This reflects poorly on campus hygiene and has not been addressed.

title: Sports ground not maintained
description: The sports ground has large potholes and uneven surfaces. A student twisted their ankle during practice last week. The ground has not been maintained for over a year.

title: Student verbally abused by senior faculty
description: A senior professor verbally abused a student in front of the entire class using language that was demeaning and unprofessional. Multiple students witnessed the incident.

title: Lab assistant demanding money
description: The laboratory assistant is allegedly demanding informal payments from students to ensure their practical marks are recorded correctly. Three students have reported this privately.

title: Peer pressure to change answers
description: During a group assignment a student was pressured by group members to change their submission to match incorrect answers. When the student refused they were excluded from the group.

title: Student being stalked on campus
description: A female student is being followed and stalked on campus by another student. She has reported the behaviour to the warden but no action has been taken and the stalking continues.

title: Professor singling out students
description: A professor consistently singles out and humiliates specific students during lectures asking them questions designed to embarrass them in front of the class.

title: Derogatory comments about learning disability
description: A student with a diagnosed learning disability has been subjected to mocking comments by a faculty member regarding their pace of learning in front of other students.

title: Group chat used to spread rumours
description: A private group chat is being used to spread false rumours about a student's personal life affecting their reputation and mental wellbeing. Screenshots have been documented.

title: Faculty asking personal questions
description: A faculty member repeatedly asks students intrusive personal questions about their family finances and relationships during one-on-one academic sessions making students very uncomfortable.

title: Student forced to apologize publicly
description: A student was forced by a professor to apologize in front of the entire class for questioning the professor's explanation during a lecture. The apology was publicly humiliating and unjustified.

title: Anti-social element enters campus
description: A person with no student ID has been regularly entering the campus and has been seen intimidating students near the library. Security has been informed but the person continues to gain entry.

title: Tuition fee paid but portal not updated
description: I paid my tuition fee for the second semester through online transfer two weeks ago. The payment has been debited from my account but the university portal still shows dues outstanding.

title: Wrong amount shown in fee challan
description: The fee challan issued by the accounts office shows an incorrect higher amount compared to the published fee structure on the college website. I cannot understand the basis for the additional charges.

title: Sports fee charged for non-participants
description: A sports development fee is being charged to all students including those who do not participate in any sports activity and have never used any sports facility.

title: Fellowship not credited despite approval
description: My AICTE fellowship was approved in September but the quarterly amount has not been credited to my account. The scholarship office says the funds are with the accounts department.

title: No receipt for miscellaneous fee
description: I was asked to pay a miscellaneous development fee of Rs 2500 in cash at the administrative counter. No receipt was issued and the payment does not appear in my student account.

title: Bank account update not processed
description: I updated my bank account details with the scholarship office in June for direct benefit transfer. The scholarship is still being sent to my old closed account.

title: Penalty for late fee without prior notice
description: A late fee penalty was added to my account without any prior notification or grace period communication. I was unaware the deadline had changed and could not arrange funds in time.

title: Exam fee paid but not registered
description: I paid the examination fee before the deadline and have the payment receipt. However I was not registered for the examinations and my name does not appear on the hall ticket list.

title: Discrepancy in scholarship disbursal
description: The scholarship amount disbursed to students in my category varies significantly without any published justification. Some students received full amounts while others with the same income certificate received less.

title: Security deposit never refunded
description: I vacated the hostel at the end of the last academic year and submitted all the required documents. My security deposit of Rs 5000 has not been refunded after eight months.

title: Bonafide certificate delayed
description: I applied for a bonafide certificate required for my bank education loan three weeks ago. It has still not been issued and the bank is threatening to cancel my loan application.

title: Exam schedule conflict not resolved
description: Two of my end-semester examinations are scheduled on the same date and time. I reported this clash to the examination section one month ago but no revised schedule has been issued.

title: Course registration portal crashed
description: The online portal for course registration crashed on the last day of registration. Students who could not register were told to appear in person but the office was closed.

title: Grade correction not processed
description: I applied for a grade correction with documentary evidence four months ago. The application was acknowledged but no action has been taken and my transcript still shows the wrong grade.

title: Duplicate marksheet not issued
description: My original marksheet was lost by the examination section during processing. I applied for a duplicate over three months ago and it has still not been issued.

title: Scholarship renewal form rejected incorrectly
description: My scholarship renewal form was rejected citing a missing document that was clearly attached to the submission. The scholarship office has not acknowledged the resubmission.

title: Course completion certificate not issued
description: I completed a certification course offered by the college six months ago. The completion certificate has not been issued despite repeated requests to the continuing education department.

title: Wrong department shown on student ID
description: My student identity card shows the wrong department. This has caused issues during laboratory access and examination entry where my identity is questioned.

title: Alumni registration not accepted
description: I have been trying to register on the college alumni portal for networking and job opportunities. My registration has been pending for four months with no response from the alumni cell.

title: Affiliation certificate not provided
description: My employer has requested an affiliation certificate from my college but the administrative office has not issued it for three months. This is delaying my background verification process.

title: Hostel mess serving non-vegetarian food to vegetarians
description: The hostel mess has repeatedly served non-vegetarian food in the vegetarian section despite multiple written complaints. Several students have strong dietary restrictions being violated.

title: No medical facility near hostel
description: There is no medical room or nurse on duty in the hostel premises. When a student fell ill at midnight the nearest medical help was a 20-minute auto ride away.

title: Warden denying night passes
description: The hostel warden is denying night out passes to students who need to attend family emergencies citing unofficial rules not mentioned in the hostel manual.

title: Hostel gate locked before prescribed time
description: The hostel gate is being locked at 8 PM instead of the prescribed 10 PM. Students returning from the library or evening sessions are locked out and forced to climb walls.

title: Room allocation based on favouritism
description: There are credible allegations that single occupancy rooms and rooms with better amenities are being allocated to students known to the warden through personal connections.

title: Electrical wiring exposed in hostel room
description: The electrical wiring in Room 314 is exposed and has given electric shocks to two students already. Maintenance was informed immediately but has not sent anyone for a week.

title: No laundry facility in hostel
description: The hostel has no laundry facility or washing area with running water. Students are forced to wash clothes in bathrooms which are shared among twenty people.

title: Guests allowed inside without checks
description: The hostel does not verify the identity of guests entering the campus. Unknown individuals have been seen entering the hostel corridors creating security concerns for residents.

title: Hostel internet speed very slow
description: The internet bandwidth allocated to the hostel is so insufficient that even loading course material takes several minutes. Online examination platforms time out regularly.

title: Mess food portions very insufficient
description: The food portions served at the hostel mess have been reduced significantly without any corresponding reduction in mess fees. Students are leaving meals hungry.

title: Bus driver not following designated route
description: The college bus on Route 3 is taking a longer route than designated adding thirty extra minutes to the journey. The driver has not been responsive to passenger requests to follow the correct route.

title: No bus shelter at pickup point
description: The designated college bus pickup point has no shelter. Students wait in the open sun or rain for up to thirty minutes every morning with no protection from the elements.

title: Special bus for examination cancelled
description: The college had promised a special bus service for the examination week for outstation students. This service was cancelled the evening before the exams with no alternative provided.

title: Driver playing loud music
description: The bus driver plays extremely loud music during the journey making it impossible for students to sleep review notes or have a conversation. Requests to reduce the volume are ignored.

title: Bus timings changed without notice
description: The morning bus pick-up timing was changed from 7:30 AM to 6:45 AM without informing students. Several students missed the bus on the first day and were marked absent.

title: Bus not sanitized during flu season
description: During the ongoing flu season the college buses have not been sanitized at all. Students sharing seats in an enclosed bus during illness outbreaks is a preventable risk.

title: Female students not given priority seating
description: Female students are not given priority seating as stated in the transport policy. Male students occupying front seats refuse to move and the conductor does not intervene.

title: New students unaware of bus routes
description: New students joining midway through the semester are not informed about bus routes timings or pass procedures. The transport office does not have any published guide.

title: Bus attendance not matching actual students
description: The transport attendance register shows students as present on days they did not board the bus. This creates compliance and accountability issues.

title: Emergency helpline not working on bus
description: The emergency helpline number displayed inside the college buses has been non-functional for months. Students have no way to report incidents during travel.

title: New books not procured for new syllabus
description: The library has not procured books for three subjects introduced in the revised curriculum this year. Students have no reference material and cannot afford to buy all titles.

title: Library computers very slow
description: The computers available in the digital library section are very old and extremely slow. Loading a research paper takes several minutes and they frequently freeze during use.

title: Books not returned by faculty on time
description: Several faculty members have borrowed books reserved for students and have not returned them for months. The library does not enforce return deadlines for faculty.

title: Thesis submission rejected at library
description: My final year thesis was rejected by the library for binding format issues. The library had never communicated the specific format requirements to students beforehand.

title: No access to e-resources from home
description: Students cannot access the college's subscribed e-journals and databases from off-campus. During examination and project season this severely limits research capability.

title: Librarian absent frequently
description: The chief librarian is absent for several days each week and there is no substitute with authority to approve book reservations or handle complaints during these absences.

title: Library catalogue not updated
description: The physical catalogue at the library entrance lists books that are no longer available and does not include recently acquired titles. Students waste time searching for books that do not exist.

title: Group study room always occupied by faculty
description: The only group study room in the library is consistently used by faculty members for private meetings. Students who book the room in advance are turned away.

title: Photocopying machine broken for weeks
description: The photocopying machine in the library has been out of service for three weeks. Students needing to copy reference material must go off-campus causing delays and additional costs.

title: No night reading facility in library
description: The library closes at 5 PM and has no night reading room. During examination season students have no campus space to study quietly in the evenings and nights.

title: Lab experiment not matching syllabus
description: The experiments being conducted in the Physics laboratory this semester do not match the prescribed syllabus. Students risk failing the practical examination on topics they have not been trained on.

title: Reagents expired in chemistry lab
description: Multiple reagents in the chemistry laboratory are past their expiry dates. Using expired chemicals produces incorrect results and may pose health risks to students.

title: Lab instructor not qualified
description: The laboratory instructor assigned to the advanced electronics lab appears to have no knowledge of the subject matter. Practical sessions have been unproductive and students are not learning.

title: No documentation for lab procedures
description: There are no written standard operating procedures for any of the laboratory experiments. Students follow verbal instructions that vary between batches leading to inconsistent outcomes.

title: Observation books collected but not returned
description: Laboratory observation books submitted in September have not been returned by the instructor. Students cannot use previous observations for upcoming practicals.

title: Safety drill never conducted in labs
description: No fire safety or chemical spill drill has been conducted in any laboratory this academic year. Students do not know the procedures in case of a laboratory emergency.

title: Lab sessions clash with other classes
description: Several students have laboratory sessions scheduled at the same time as mandatory lectures. The timetable conflict has been raised but not resolved.

title: No ventilation in chemistry laboratory
description: The chemistry laboratory has inadequate ventilation. During experiments involving volatile chemicals students are exposed to harmful fumes without proper exhaust systems.

title: Viva marks seem predetermined
description: The viva voce marks for laboratory practicals appear to be predetermined. Students who answer questions correctly are given the same marks as those who cannot answer at all.

title: Equipment reservation system not working
description: The online equipment reservation system for the advanced lab is not functional. Students cannot pre-book equipment and the first-come-first-serve approach means many leave without completing practicals.

title: No placement support for non-IT students
description: The training and placement cell focuses exclusively on IT companies. Students from Mechanical Civil and Electrical branches receive no sector-specific guidance or company connections.

title: No medical insurance for students
description: The college does not offer or facilitate any group medical insurance for students. During a recent laboratory accident the injured student had to bear the full medical cost personally.

title: Student union elections not held
description: Student union elections have not been conducted for two consecutive academic years. Students have no formal representative body to present collective concerns to the administration.

title: College prospectus information incorrect
description: The college prospectus advertises facilities and faculty qualifications that do not reflect reality. Students chose this institution based on inaccurate information.

title: No feedback mechanism for faculty
description: Students have no formal anonymous mechanism to provide feedback on teaching quality. The only formal evaluations are controlled by the same department the faculty belongs to.

title: Wi-Fi password changed without notice
description: The campus Wi-Fi password is changed periodically without informing students. Students attending online sessions or downloading study material are suddenly disconnected with no explanation.

title: Emergency contact not available at night
description: The emergency contact number listed on the college website goes unanswered after 6 PM. Students in distress after hours have no institutional point of contact.

title: College events always on weekdays
description: All major college events fests and workshops are scheduled on weekdays disrupting regular academic schedules. Attending events means missing classes and students are penalized for absence.

title: No support for international students
description: International exchange students receive no dedicated orientation support administrative assistance or cultural integration help. They are left to navigate bureaucracy entirely on their own.

title: No student locker facility
description: The college has no locker facility for students who travel long distances and need to store personal belongings safely during the day. Valuable items left in classrooms are frequently stolen.

title: Proxy attendance being marked
description: Proxy attendance is being marked in several classes with the professor's knowledge. Students who are genuinely absent are being marked present by classmates.

title: Subject taught by unqualified substitute
description: The core subject of Algorithms is being taught by a substitute faculty member who has no background in computer science. The quality of instruction is poor and students are falling behind.

title: Marks for university exam not tallying
description: The marks for my university examination as communicated to me verbally by the professor do not match what was submitted to the university. The discrepancy is of 12 marks.

title: Open book exam rules changed midway
description: The professor changed the rules of the open book examination midway through the exam session saying students could no longer refer to notes. This was unfair to students who had prepared accordingly.

title: No mentor-mentee system
description: The college's published mentor-mentee programme exists only on paper. No actual mentoring sessions are conducted and students in academic difficulty have no access to guidance.

title: Fake grievance test submission
description: This is a test submission to verify the grievance portal is working correctly. Please discard.

title: Exam postponed without proper notice
description: My examination was postponed but I received the notice only on the day of the exam via WhatsApp. I had already travelled from my hometown and incurred significant travel expenses.

title: Online class link not shared
description: The professor did not share the link for online classes for an entire week. Students had no way to attend and have missed a significant portion of the syllabus.

title: Academic calendar not followed
description: The published academic calendar is not being followed. Events exams and holidays are being changed repeatedly without formal communication causing confusion and missed preparation.

title: Group project marks not distributed fairly
description: In a group project one student did all the work but all group members received the same marks. The student who worked raised this with the professor who dismissed the concern.

title: Fire extinguishers not serviced
description: The fire extinguishers across the campus are overdue for their mandatory annual service. Several show red tags indicating they are empty or non-functional.

title: Classroom overcrowding exceeds safety limit
description: A classroom designed for sixty students is being used to seat ninety-five. This violates safety norms and makes it impossible to maintain any study environment.

title: Sewage smell in academic block
description: There is a persistent sewage smell throughout the ground floor of the academic block. The source has been identified as a broken underground pipe but repair work has not started.

title: Damaged roads inside campus
description: The internal campus roads are severely potholed and damaged. Multiple students have fallen off bicycles and one motorcycle accident was reported. Repairs have been pending for a year.

title: Water cooler serving warm water
description: All water coolers on campus are serving room-temperature water. The cooling units appear to have failed. In summer heat this means students have no access to safe cool drinking water.

title: Air conditioning broken in server room
description: The air conditioning in the server room has been malfunctioning for three weeks. The temperature is affecting server performance and students working in the adjacent lab are experiencing frequent system crashes.

title: Campus boundary wall broken
description: A section of the campus boundary wall near the sports ground has collapsed. This creates a direct entry point for outsiders and a security risk that has been ignored for two weeks.

title: No CCTV in examination halls
description: There are no CCTV cameras in any of the examination halls. This has allowed widespread use of unfair means in recent examinations and honest students are disadvantaged.

title: Temporary classrooms without proper flooring
description: The additional classrooms constructed as temporary structures have no proper flooring. Dust enters continuously making the environment unhealthy especially for students with respiratory conditions.

title: No proper drainage in ground floor labs
description: The ground floor chemistry laboratory floods during heavy rain due to insufficient drainage. Valuable equipment and student records stored there get damaged every monsoon season.

title: Student humiliated during presentation
description: During a class presentation a professor repeatedly interrupted and laughed at a student's work in front of fifty other students. The student was in tears and left the classroom.

title: Group of seniors blocking junior access to gym
description: A group of senior students routinely occupies the entire gymnasium during hours allocated to juniors. When juniors try to enter they are intimidated and turned away.

title: Threatening note left in hostel room
description: A student found a handwritten threatening note left inside their locked hostel room. The identity of the person who left the note is unknown. Security and warden were informed but no investigation has begun.

title: Professor commenting on student's social media
description: A professor has been commenting on a student's personal social media posts in a way that is intrusive and inappropriate. When the student asked the professor to stop they were threatened with lower grades.

title: Student from reserved category denied help
description: A student from a reserved category background is being denied academic help by classmates who refuse to share notes or include them in study groups based on their category.

title: Romantic proposal not taken no for answer
description: A student made an unwanted romantic proposal to a female student. After being clearly rejected the student has continued to follow and contact her persistently despite multiple refusals.

title: Seniors demanding free labour
description: Senior students are compelling juniors to complete their assignments and projects without compensation under the threat of social exclusion and spreading false information.

title: Academic rivalry turned hostile
description: An academic rivalry between two students has turned hostile with one student spreading false academic misconduct allegations against the other to the department head.

title: Unequal treatment during examinations
description: A student with a certified writing disability was denied extra time during the examination despite having submitted the required medical documentation to the examination office.

title: Anonymous complaint filed against student
description: An anonymous complaint was filed against a student accusing them of academic misconduct. The complaint contained false allegations and the identity of the complainant has not been investigated.

title: Examination fee hike not justified
description: The examination fee for this academic year has been increased by 40% without any official justification circular or announcement. Students are paying significantly more with no explanation.

title: Scholarship linked to CGPA not updated
description: My CGPA meets the scholarship threshold but the scholarship portal still shows me as ineligible because my latest semester marks have not been updated in the system.

title: Fee paid but showing outstanding
description: My fee payment made via demand draft was submitted to the accounts counter three weeks ago. The receipt is held by the accounts office and the portal still shows my dues as outstanding.

title: Fake fee receipt distributed
description: A fake fee receipt is being circulated among students by another student collecting money and issuing unofficial receipts. This has defrauded at least five students.

title: Sports scholarship not disbursed
description: I was awarded a sports scholarship based on my state-level achievement. The scholarship was announced in July but the amount has not been disbursed despite it being November.

title: Development fee purpose not disclosed
description: A development fee of Rs 3000 is charged annually but no information is ever provided about what projects or activities this fee funds. Requests for transparency have not been answered.

title: Mess fee charged for vacation months
description: Hostel mess fees were charged for the two months when the hostel was officially closed during vacations. Students who were not on campus should not have been charged for this period.

title: Alumni donation not acknowledged
description: I made a donation to the college alumni fund as requested during the alumni meet. The donation was not acknowledged and does not appear in the alumni fund records.

title: Stipend for internship not paid
description: I completed a mandatory internship arranged by the college where the host company agreed to pay a stipend. The stipend was collected by the college placement cell but not passed on to me.

title: Fine imposed without evidence
description: A fine was imposed on my student account for alleged damage to college property. I was not informed of the specific damage alleged and no evidence or photograph was provided.

title: Convocation ceremony delayed unreasonably
description: Our graduating batch is the third consecutive batch to have the convocation delayed. The degree certificates are being withheld until after the ceremony which itself has no scheduled date.

title: Department transfer not processed
description: I submitted a formal request for inter-department transfer in July as permitted by the college policy. The request has neither been approved nor rejected and I am now three months into the wrong programme.

title: Student discipline committee decision unfair
description: The student discipline committee penalized a student without conducting a fair hearing. The student was not given an opportunity to present their side and the punishment was disproportionate.

title: Internship NOC not issued
description: The college administration has not issued the No Objection Certificate needed for my internship at a reputed company. The delay has caused the offer to be at risk of being withdrawn.

title: Incorrect category in admission record
description: My admission record shows the wrong category which is affecting my eligibility for category-based scholarships and reservations. Correction requests have been submitted three times.

title: Circular issued without date
description: Official circulars from the administration regularly lack issue dates making it impossible for students to know whether communications are current or outdated.

title: Examination hall change not communicated
description: The examination hall was changed on the day of the examination without any notice. Several students went to the wrong hall and were marked absent for that paper.

title: Portal not accessible on mobile browsers
description: The student portal is not accessible on mobile browsers. Students who do not have laptops or desktops cannot access their timetables grades or exam schedules conveniently.

title: Late fee notification via student portal only
description: The accounts office issues due date reminders only through the student portal which many students do not check regularly. This results in avoidable late fee penalties.

title: Event permission request ignored
description: I submitted a formal request to organize a technical event through the student activity cell. The request was submitted six weeks ago and has received no response.

title: Hostel food same every day
description: The hostel mess serves the same menu every single day with no variety. Students are paying for a full meal plan but the nutritional diversity and quality are completely unacceptable.

title: Room heater not provided in winter
description: Students in the northern hostel block have no room heaters despite temperatures dropping below 5 degrees Celsius. Several students have fallen sick with cold and flu.

title: Hostel room shared by too many students
description: My hostel room originally designed for two students now houses four. There is no space to place luggage or study at the desk. The allocation change was made without consent.

title: Students smoking in hostel corridors
description: Smoking is taking place openly in hostel corridors affecting non-smoking students including those with respiratory conditions. The warden is aware but takes no enforcement action.

title: Hostel staff demanding tips
description: Hostel housekeeping staff are demanding tips from students in exchange for cleaning their rooms and have been leaving rooms unclean when tips are not given.

title: Noise disturbance in hostel during exam week
description: Students living in one section of the hostel are holding loud gatherings even during examination week. The warden does not enforce any quiet hours during this critical period.

title: Hostel admission waitlist not transparent
description: The hostel waitlist process is not transparent. Students who applied earlier than others have been allotted rooms later without any explanation of how priority is determined.

title: Hostel complaint register not maintained
description: When I tried to enter my complaint in the hostel complaint register I was told by the warden that no such register exists. The college policy requires one to be maintained.

title: Hostel maintenance requests ignored
description: I submitted three written maintenance requests over six weeks for a broken ceiling fan in my room. None of the requests have been acknowledged or acted upon.

title: Prohibited items found during room search
description: During a hostel room search conducted without prior notice prohibited items were found in my room. I was penalised but I did not bring those items. The process was not impartial.

title: Bus passes not valid on alternate routes
description: My bus pass is valid only for one specific route. When that bus breaks down or is cancelled there is no provision to board an alternate college bus leaving me stranded.

title: Waiting area at bus stop has no benches
description: The bus waiting area outside the college has no seating. Students with heavy bags wait for up to 30 minutes in the sun and rain with no shelter or facility.

title: Bus route covers no student residential area
description: The college bus routes were designed years ago and no longer cover areas where most current students live. A large proportion of students have to arrange their own transport.

title: New student not informed of bus facility
description: I was not informed that a college bus facility exists or how to register for it during admission orientation. I have been paying private auto fares for three months unnecessarily.

title: Bus conductor misbehaving with students
description: The conductor of Bus Route 6 speaks rudely to students and has on two occasions physically pushed students while collecting bus passes. Complaints to the transport office have been verbal only.

title: No bus during state holidays
description: The college has classes on some state government holidays but no bus service is provided. Students on bus routes are not informed in advance and must arrange alternate transport.

title: Incorrect bus route on college website
description: The bus route information on the college website is outdated and does not match actual routes. New students relying on this information are missing their buses on the first day.

title: Bus fee increased mid-year
description: The college bus fee was increased mid-academic year by Rs 500 per month. The increase was announced only one week in advance with no justification.

title: Driver using phone while driving
description: The driver of the Route 5 bus uses a mobile phone while driving on the highway. Multiple students have reported this safety concern to the transport office with no action taken.

title: Bus not stopping at designated stop
description: The college bus regularly bypasses one of the designated pick-up stops without reason. Students at that stop frequently miss the bus and are late for morning classes.

title: Library books reserved but not available
description: I reserved a book through the online library reservation system and received a confirmation. When I went to collect it I was told the book was not available and the system had an error.

title: Library charging for borrower card
description: The library is charging students Rs 200 for a borrower card that was previously provided free. No official policy change was communicated to students.

title: Newspaper and magazine section neglected
description: The newspaper and magazine reading section in the library has not been restocked for six months. Publications that are more than half a year old are still the newest available.

title: Library blocking social media on study Wi-Fi
description: The library Wi-Fi is blocking access to several academic websites including GitHub ResearchGate and certain international university library portals used for research.

title: Missing pages in newly acquired books
description: Several books recently acquired by the library have missing or misprinted pages. These defects should have been identified before making them available to students.

title: No accessibility features in digital library
description: The digital library portal has no accessibility features for visually impaired students. There are no text-to-speech options keyboard navigation or contrast settings.

title: Faculty hoarding multiple copies
description: A faculty member has borrowed seven copies of the same textbook using student IDs without student knowledge. Students in that course cannot borrow the required book.

title: Library helpdesk understaffed
description: There is only one library staff member on duty on most days. Students queue for extended periods to borrow return or request assistance. The help desk is often unattended.

title: Old edition books only in library
description: The library holds only old editions of key textbooks while the syllabus references the latest editions. The differences between editions cause confusion and incorrect learning.

title: No provision for book donation
description: Several students and alumni have offered to donate books to the library. There is no process or point of contact for receiving donated books and the offers have been turned down.

title: Protective gear not provided in welding lab
description: Students in the Mechanical Engineering welding laboratory are not provided with welding shields or protective aprons. This is a serious safety violation in a high-risk activity.

title: Lab reports not marked fairly
description: Laboratory reports have not been returned after grading and students have no idea what marks they received or what errors were made. There is no feedback on laboratory performance.

title: Equipment booking system biased
description: The equipment reservation system in the research laboratory always shows certain projects as having priority over others with no published allocation policy.

title: No drinking water near lab block
description: There is no drinking water facility near the laboratory block. Students conducting three-hour practicals must walk to the main building to drink water.

title: Lab instructor absent without notice
description: The laboratory instructor for the Networks lab was absent for three consecutive sessions without informing students. The sessions were held without supervision.

title: Expensive consumables not provided
description: Students are required to purchase their own consumables for laboratory experiments that were listed as provided in the fee schedule. This is an additional financial burden.

title: Lab timings conflicting with prayer times
description: The laboratory sessions have been scheduled during Friday afternoon prayer times without consideration for Muslim students who need to leave campus briefly.

title: Sensitive equipment left unattended
description: Expensive and sensitive laboratory equipment is regularly left unattended overnight. There have been instances of unexplained damage and wear suggesting misuse.

title: Safety data sheets not accessible
description: Safety data sheets for hazardous chemicals are not posted in the chemistry laboratory. Students handling chemicals have no immediate reference for handling emergencies.

title: Lab exam dates not communicated early
description: The dates for practical examinations are announced only one week in advance. Students with multiple practicals scheduled close together do not have adequate preparation time.

title: No formal complaint box on campus
description: There is no physical complaint box anywhere on campus. The only avenue for complaints is direct communication with office staff which many students are afraid to use.

title: College website information outdated
description: The college website shows faculty profiles for professors who left the institution two years ago and does not list current faculty. Prospective students and visitors are misled.

title: No sexual harassment committee visible
description: The Internal Complaints Committee as mandated by the POSH Act appears to exist only on paper. There is no visibility of its members contact information or complaint procedure.

title: Student ID not working for campus access
description: My student ID card is not activating the electronic access control for the library and computer lab. I was told the card needs to be reprogrammed but the IT office has not done this for three weeks.

title: Printing quota too low
description: The printing quota allocated to each student per semester is insufficient for the volume of assignments reports and project documents required. Students are spending heavily on external printing.

title: No acknowledgment of complaint submitted
description: I submitted a formal written complaint to the principal's office three weeks ago. I have not received any acknowledgment and when I enquire I am told to wait without being given a reference number.

title: Classroom keys misplaced regularly
description: Classroom keys are misplaced by staff regularly causing the first fifteen to twenty minutes of each class to be wasted while students and faculty wait outside. This is a systemic problem.

title: No peer learning programme
description: The college has no structured peer learning or tutoring programme. Students who need additional help have no institutional support between classes and formal tutoring.

title: Exam results portal down on result day
description: The examination result portal consistently crashes on the day results are released due to high simultaneous access. Students have to wait for days to access their results.

title: No alumni interaction programme
description: The college has no programme connecting current students with alumni for career guidance mentorship or networking. Many students are unaware of career paths in their field.

title: Abusive language used by professor
description: The professor teaching Engineering Mathematics uses abusive language in class when students ask questions. This behaviour has been reported verbally to the HOD but continues.

title: Assignment deadline changed without notice
description: The deadline for the term assignment was moved forward by one week without consulting students. Many had planned their submissions around the original deadline and could not comply.

title: Course material not uploaded on portal
description: The professor has not uploaded any course material study notes or reference links on the student portal. Students are entirely dependent on whatever is covered in class.

title: Supplementary exam result delayed
description: I appeared in the supplementary examination six months ago. My result has not yet been declared and I am unable to register for the next year of study.

title: Duplicate grievance about grading
description: My mid-semester exam paper was graded incorrectly. I scored full marks in three questions but was given partial credit without explanation despite requesting re-evaluation.

title: Online exam platform crashed during exam
description: The online examination platform crashed midway through my paper. I lost my progress and was given only ten minutes of additional time which was grossly insufficient.

title: Professor attending class only 30% of time
description: Based on the class attendance record that was accidentally displayed the professor has attended only 30% of scheduled classes. The remaining were either cancelled or taken by an unqualified substitute.

title: Marks deducted for handwriting
description: A professor deducted marks from students' written answers citing poor handwriting rather than the correctness of the answer. This is not a valid criterion in the marking scheme.

title: Extra credit not counted
description: I submitted optional extra credit work as announced by the professor. When marks were released the extra credit had not been factored in and the professor says it was never mandatory.

title: Question paper out of syllabus
description: The end-semester examination question paper contained questions from topics not included in the syllabus as communicated to students. Multiple students could not answer large portions of the paper.

title: Rainwater entering classroom through roof
description: The classroom in Block C second floor has a damaged roof from which rainwater leaks during monsoon. Students and equipment are at risk and classes cannot be conducted during rain.

title: No ramp for wheelchair access in library
description: The library entrance has only steps with no ramp. A student using a wheelchair cannot enter the library independently. This violates disability accessibility norms.

title: Generator exhaust near classroom windows
description: The generator exhaust pipe is located directly below the windows of Classroom 102. Fumes from the generator enter the classroom during power cuts making the environment unhealthy.

title: Electrical wiring not covered in corridors
description: Exposed electrical wiring can be seen hanging from the ceiling in multiple corridors of the old academic block. This is a serious safety hazard that has been present for months.

title: ATM on campus not working for weeks
description: The only ATM on the campus has been non-functional for three weeks. Students who rely on cash for canteen purchases and local vendors are inconvenienced.

title: Insufficient seating in canteen
description: The canteen has seating for only eighty students during lunch hours when more than four hundred students visit. Students eat standing or on staircases causing hygiene and safety issues.

title: Projector screen torn in classroom
description: The projector screen in Room 108 is torn and does not display clearly. All visual presentations in this room are affected. The issue has been reported but no repair has been made.

title: No emergency light in stairways
description: The stairways in the academic block have no emergency lighting. During a recent fire drill the stairs were pitch dark when the main power was simulated as cut.

title: Water leaking from lab sink into electrical panel
description: Water from the laboratory sink is dripping into the electrical panel in the wall below. This is an extremely dangerous combination that could cause electrocution.

title: Boundary wall too low near girls hostel
description: The boundary wall near the girls hostel is only four feet high in one section. This is a serious security concern and has been reported to administration with no remedial action.

title: Ragging complaint dismissed without inquiry
description: I filed a formal ragging complaint with the anti-ragging committee. The committee dismissed the complaint in two days without conducting any formal inquiry or speaking to witnesses.

title: Student photographs shared without consent
description: Photographs taken during a college event were shared on the institution's official social media accounts without obtaining consent from all students appearing in them.

title: Professor giving preferential project topics
description: The professor distributes research project topics by personal preference giving interesting and marketable topics to favoured students while assigning generic topics to others.

title: Class representative abusing position
description: The class representative has been misusing their position by selectively informing certain students about class cancellations and examination schedule changes.

title: Student account hacked and misused
description: A student's college email account appears to have been hacked. Emails are being sent from the account to faculty and administration in the student's name without their knowledge.

title: Seniors blocking access to senior student
description: A group of seniors has been physically blocking a junior student's entry to the college cafeteria for two weeks and telling them to eat only at specific times.

title: Faculty demanding personal favours
description: A faculty member has been suggesting to students that personal favours such as accompanying them to events will result in better internal assessment marks.

title: Humiliation in front of parents
description: During a parent-teacher meeting a professor humiliated a student by sharing private academic struggles and personal details in front of other parents without the student's consent.

title: Student isolated by entire class
description: An entire section is ignoring and isolating one student based on instructions from a senior student. The isolated student is experiencing severe psychological distress.

title: False academic complaint by rival student
description: A student filed a false academic misconduct complaint against a rival to gain competitive advantage. The complaint led to a disciplinary proceeding that took three months to resolve.

title: Caution money used without permission
description: The caution money deposited by students for laboratory equipment has been used for other purposes without student consent. This was revealed during an accidental disclosure at a faculty meeting.

title: Scholarship stopped without explanation
description: My merit scholarship which was active for two years has suddenly stopped being credited. No explanation or notice has been provided and the scholarship office is unresponsive.

title: Fee structure different from brochure
description: The fee structure currently being charged by the college accounts office is significantly higher than what was published in the admission brochure I received. The difference is Rs 18000 per year.

title: Bus fee collected but service stopped
description: The annual bus fee was collected at the start of the semester. The bus service for our route was discontinued in the middle of the semester due to low ridership without refunding the fee.

title: Sports kit not provided despite fee
description: A sports kit development fee is included in the fee structure. No sports kit has ever been provided to students and no explanation is given when students ask.

title: Exam form fee collected twice
description: Students in one section were asked to pay the examination form fee twice. The second collection was unofficial and no receipts were issued.

title: Fee waiver approval not communicated
description: My fee waiver application was submitted in June. I have received no approval or rejection and the accounts office is charging late fees for unpaid dues that should be covered by the waiver.

title: Laboratory breakage charges unfair
description: Laboratory breakage charges are being deducted uniformly from all students regardless of whether the breakage occurred in their session or whether they were responsible.

title: Canteen token system not transparent
