description: The canteen token system used for subsidized meals has an opaque balance system. Students cannot see how many tokens remain or review their transaction history.

title: Scholarship distributed but taxed informally
description: A portion of the scholarship amount disbursed to students is being informally deducted as an administrative fee before crediting. No documentation or authorization exists for this deduction.

title: Principal not available for complaint
description: I have been trying to meet the Principal to file a formal complaint for three weeks. Every visit to the office results in being told the Principal is unavailable.

title: Complaint acknowledgment not given
description: After filing a written complaint with the administration office I was not given any acknowledgment receipt or reference number. There is no way to track whether the complaint was received.

title: Wrong date of birth on university record
description: My date of birth is incorrectly recorded in the university academic record. This is causing issues with government identification documents and job applications.

title: Student welfare fund applications ignored
description: Applications for emergency student welfare fund assistance have been submitted by three students in financial crisis. All three applications have been pending for over two months.

title: Annual report of the college incorrect
description: The annual report submitted by the college to the regulatory body contains data that does not match ground reality including inflated placement numbers.

title: Anti-ragging form not accepted
description: Students are being asked to submit the anti-ragging undertaking form again despite having already submitted it during admission. The original submissions appear to have been lost.

title: Change of address not updated
description: I updated my address in the college records six months ago. All official correspondence is still being sent to my old address causing me to miss important notifications.

title: Internal examination dates clash with industry event
description: The internal examination dates were scheduled on the same days as a major national-level industry event that several students were representing the college at.

title: Examination result withheld without reason
description: My examination result for the fourth semester has been withheld without any communication of the reason. The examination section says there is a query but has not specified what it is.

title: Student file lost by administration
description: My original admission documents which were submitted to and retained by the administration office have been lost. The office cannot locate the file and has asked me to resubmit all documents.

title: Hostel warden playing favourites
description: The hostel warden grants extended curfew passes and other privileges to a select group of students while denying the same requests from others without justification.

title: Hostel mess closed during examination week
description: The hostel mess was closed for two days during the end-semester examination week citing staff leave. Students preparing for exams had no food facility on campus.

title: Cockroaches in hostel dining area
description: Cockroaches have been spotted on multiple occasions in the hostel dining area near food preparation counters. This is a serious hygiene violation that the warden has not addressed.

title: New hostel residents not given proper induction
description: New residents joining the hostel mid-semester were not given any induction about rules facilities emergency contacts or complaint procedures. They are completely uninformed.

title: Hostel room locks changed without notice
description: The locks on all hostel rooms were changed overnight without prior notice. Students who returned late were unable to enter their rooms and no spare keys were available.

title: Hostel residents denied re-entry after vacation
description: Several hostel residents returning after the Diwali vacation were denied entry because their re-entry passes had expired by one day. No grace period had been communicated.

title: No working washroom on ground floor hostel
description: Both washrooms on the ground floor of the boys hostel are non-functional due to plumbing failures. More than forty students are sharing two washrooms on upper floors.

title: Hostel menu not displayed in advance
description: The hostel mess does not display its weekly menu in advance. Students with dietary restrictions or allergies cannot plan their meals and are often surprised by dishes they cannot eat.

title: Night guard sleeping on duty
description: The night security guard at the hostel gate is consistently found asleep. Unauthorised persons have entered the hostel multiple times during night hours.

title: Student locked out of hostel room by roommate
description: A student is being locked out of their shared hostel room by their roommate during late-night study sessions. The dispute has been raised with the warden who has not intervened.

title: College bus GPS tracking not working
description: The GPS tracking feature on the college bus app has not been functional for two months. Students cannot track the bus arrival time and consistently miss it.

title: Bus schedule not matching academic calendar
description: The bus schedule has not been updated to reflect the revised academic calendar. During examination days buses operate on a normal timetable which does not match student needs.

title: Bus breaking down frequently
description: The bus on Route 2 has broken down four times this month. Students are stranded on the highway each time and no emergency transport is ever sent.

title: Bus driver refusing entry after certain stop
description: The bus driver on Route 4 refuses to allow new passengers to board after a certain stop claiming the bus is full even when seats are clearly visible. Students at later stops are always left behind.

title: No bus service on exam rescheduled days
description: When examinations are rescheduled to a Saturday no bus service is provided. Students must arrange private transport at short notice and additional cost.

title: Students asked to pay extra on bus
description: The bus conductor is collecting cash payments from students who do not have their pass claiming it is for issuing temporary passes. No official receipts are given for this collection.

title: Bus registration number not matching permit
description: Students noticed that the bus operating on Route 3 has a registration number different from the one listed on the permit displayed inside the vehicle. This may be a compliance violation.

title: No water cooler on college bus
description: During peak summer days the college bus has no access to drinking water for students on journeys lasting over an hour. Students are dehydrated by the time they reach college.

title: Bus making unauthorised stops
description: The college bus regularly makes unofficial stops that are not on the designated route to allow the driver's acquaintances to board. This adds fifteen minutes to the journey.

title: No feedback mechanism for transport issues
description: There is no official mechanism for students to report transport complaints. The transport office phone number goes unanswered and there is no email or online form available.

title: Library issuing books already borrowed
description: The library system issued me a book that was already checked out to another student. When I went to collect it the book was not available and the librarian could not explain the error.

title: Duplicate fine charges in library system
description: I received two fine notices for the same book return. When I pointed this out the librarian acknowledged it might be an error but said I needed to pay both and claim a refund later.

title: Reading list books not in library catalogue
description: The reading list provided by the professor for the research methodology course lists twelve titles. Nine of them are not available in the library catalogue at all.

title: Library Wi-Fi slower than mobile data
description: The library Wi-Fi is slower than mobile data networks. Students who rely on the library internet for research and project work find it practically unusable during peak hours.

title: Book condition very poor
description: Many books in the library are in very poor physical condition with torn binding broken spines and missing pages. New students are being issued damaged books without disclosure.

title: Library staff not trained on new system
description: Following the library software upgrade the staff have not been trained on the new system. Students experience delays and errors when borrowing or returning books.

title: No notification for book availability
description: The library system does not send notifications when a reserved book becomes available. Students have missed their opportunity to borrow reserved books because they were not informed.

title: Library membership not recognised after transfer
description: After transferring from another institution my previous library membership was not recognised and I was made to pay a fresh membership fee despite the inter-college transfer arrangement.

title: Important reference books locked in faculty section
description: Several important reference books required for final-year project work are locked in the faculty-only section of the library and cannot be accessed by students at all.

title: Library fine receipts not provided
description: The library is collecting fines in cash but not issuing receipts for these payments. Students have no proof of fine payment and risk being asked to pay again.

title: Radioactive material stored unsafely in lab
description: A physics laboratory has radioactive material stored in a cabinet that is not secured with a radiation warning label or proper shielding. Students are unaware of the hazard.

title: Lab practical marks not disclosed
description: Students were not informed of their individual practical marks before the final practical examination. This prevents them from understanding where improvement is needed.

title: Practical timetable clashes with theory exams
description: The timetable for practical examinations overlaps with theory end-semester examinations for three subjects. No resolution has been offered by the examination section.

title: Outdated lab manuals contradict syllabus
description: The laboratory manuals being followed are based on an older syllabus. Several experiments listed are no longer part of the course and vice versa creating confusion.

title: Lab assistant favouring students
description: The laboratory assistant gives better observation records and more time to certain students based on personal relationships. Other students complete experiments in a rush.

title: Animal lab conditions inhumane
description: The zoology laboratory conditions for live specimens are inhumane. Animals are kept in overcrowded conditions without adequate food or water.

title: No independent verification of weights
description: The weighing instruments in the chemistry laboratory are not independently verified. Students doing analytical chemistry experiments are getting wildly inconsistent results.

title: Lab key held by single person
description: The key to the computer science research laboratory is held by a single staff member who is frequently absent. Students with scheduled access cannot enter the lab.

title: Lab marks given without conducting viva
description: Laboratory final marks were awarded to several students without conducting the mandatory viva examination. This benefits those who did not prepare but penalises those who did.

title: Lab experiments repeated from previous year
description: The same set of experiments conducted last year is being repeated this year without any new additions. Students in the same lab course for two years have done nothing new.

title: No counselling for examination anxiety
description: There is no institutional support for students experiencing examination anxiety. Multiple students have dropped out or deferred examinations due to anxiety with no early intervention.

title: Cultural fest cancelled last minute
description: The annual cultural fest was cancelled one day before the event without explanation. Students and performers who had been preparing for weeks received no compensation or acknowledgment.

title: No orientation programme for freshers
description: New students received no formal orientation programme. They were unaware of facilities rules grievance procedures academic systems or campus geography for weeks.

title: Campus visitation policy too restrictive
description: The campus visitation policy prohibits parents from visiting students in the hostel or academic block without prior administrative approval. This is overly restrictive and stressful for families.

title: No transparency in internal transfer policy
description: The policy for internal transfers between departments is not publicly available. Students applying for transfers are given conflicting information by different administrative staff.

title: No space for student clubs
description: Student technical and cultural clubs have no dedicated space to meet and work. They are forced to use stairways corridors and outdoor areas for club activities.

title: Fake grievance duplicate of 305
description: My exam was graded incorrectly and I deserve a re-evaluation. The professor has not responded to any of my requests regarding my mid-semester paper.

title: College newspaper suppressed
description: The student newspaper published an article about administrative irregularities. The entire print run was confiscated by administration and the student editors were threatened with suspension.

title: No provision for remote learning accommodation
description: Students who missed classes due to documented medical emergencies are not provided with any remote learning accommodation or recorded lecture access. They fall behind permanently.

title: Professor using personal examples to embarrass students
description: A professor regularly uses students as negative examples in lecture to illustrate wrong approaches citing them by name in front of the class without consent.

title: Backlog clearance policy unclear
description: The policy for clearing backlogs is not documented and communicated differently by different professors and the examination section. Students cannot plan their academic recovery.

title: Online attendance portal not updating
description: The online attendance portal has not been updating records for the past two weeks. Manual registers are being maintained but the portal discrepancy is causing false shortage alerts.

title: Project defense rescheduled without notice
description: My final year project defense was rescheduled at 9 PM the evening before without any official communication. I only found out through a classmate.

title: Same assignment given to two batches
description: The same assignment topic was given to two batches of students. This resulted in widespread copying between batches and unfair comparison of original work.

title: Practical examination without prior syllabus
description: Students were not informed about which experiments would feature in the practical examination. The viva questions covered topics not mentioned in any available material.

title: Professor missing from grading committee
description: The professor who taught a core subject was absent from the grading committee meeting. Another professor graded papers without any familiarity with what was taught in class.

title: Attendance manually manipulated
description: There is evidence that attendance registers have been manually altered for certain students. Erased and overwritten entries are visible in multiple pages of the register.

title: Subject expert not consulted for new course
description: A new industry-relevant course was introduced without consulting any subject expert or industry representative. The content is outdated and irrelevant to current job requirements.

title: No doubt clearing sessions before exam
description: No doubt clearing or revision sessions were scheduled before the end-semester examination despite students formally requesting them. The professor said there was no time.

title: Ceiling fan falling hazard in classroom
description: A ceiling fan in Room 211 is hanging loose from its mount. It wobbles visibly during operation and there is a clear risk of it falling on students seated below.

title: Laboratory drain blocked causing overflow
description: The laboratory sink drain is blocked and overflows onto the floor during practical sessions. Students are walking through standing water near electrical equipment.

title: Classroom whiteboard not visible from back rows
description: The whiteboard in Room 303 is too small and not visible from the last four rows. Students sitting there cannot read what is written and are disadvantaged.

title: No sanitary napkin disposal in ladies washroom
description: The ladies washrooms across campus have no sanitary napkin disposal units. This is a basic hygiene requirement that has been raised multiple times with no action.

title: Lecture theatre PA system not working
description: The public address system in the main lecture theatre has been non-functional for a month. Faculty conducting large-batch lectures cannot be heard clearly beyond the fifth row.

title: Hostel roof water tank contaminated
description: The overhead water tank for Block A hostel has not been cleaned in over a year. The water has a foul smell and a greenish tint suggesting algae growth.

title: No speed breaker near college entrance
description: Vehicles enter the college at high speed through the main gate. There are no speed breakers or signage. A student was knocked down by a two-wheeler last week.

title: Flooring slippery in wet weather
description: The flooring in the ground floor corridor becomes extremely slippery when wet during rain. Three students have already slipped and one sustained a wrist injury.

title: No fire evacuation drill conducted
description: No fire evacuation drill has been conducted this academic year. Students and staff do not know the emergency procedures or evacuation routes.

title: Lift out of service for two months
description: The passenger lift in the academic block has been out of service for two months with no repair timeline. Students with disabilities and those carrying heavy equipment are severely affected.

title: Student body searched without consent
description: A student was physically searched by a security guard near the examination hall without consent or any stated reasonable cause. The student found this humiliating and invasive.

title: Private conversation recorded by classmate
description: A private conversation between two students was secretly recorded and shared with a professor by a third student. The recording was used against one student in a disciplinary proceeding.

title: Student mocked for accent
description: A student from a different state is being repeatedly mocked by classmates and on one occasion by a professor for their regional accent. The student feels unwelcome and isolated.

title: Professor reacting negatively to disability disclosure
description: When a student disclosed a learning disability to a professor to request reasonable accommodation the professor reacted dismissively and made the disclosure public in the next class.

title: Wrongful suspension threatened
description: A student was threatened with suspension if they continued to pursue a formal complaint about fee irregularities. The threat was made verbally in the principal's office.

title: Group project credit stolen
description: A student who independently completed the majority of a group project had their name removed from the submission by other group members. The professor accepted the submission without investigation.

title: Student discriminated against for political views
description: A student who expressed certain political opinions in a classroom discussion was subsequently given lower internal marks and excluded from college-sponsored opportunities.

title: Unknown person accessing student records
description: A student discovered that an unauthorised person had accessed their academic records including grades and personal contact information through an administrative login.

title: Abusive senior student not removed from hostel
description: A senior student who physically assaulted a junior six months ago was given a written warning but was not removed from the hostel. The junior still lives in fear.

title: Peer pressuring student to cheat
description: A student is being pressured by a peer to share answers during examinations with threats of social exclusion and physical intimidation if they refuse.

title: Scholarship deducted for one low grade
description: My scholarship which was awarded unconditionally at admission has been deducted because I received one low grade. The original terms did not include any grade-based condition.

title: Incorrect income certificate used for fee
description: A student's income certificate used to determine fee concession was incorrectly assessed. The income category was placed higher than actual leading to excess fee being charged.

title: Laboratory breakage deducted from all students
description: Rs 500 was deducted from every student's account as a laboratory breakage charge at the end of the semester regardless of whether they had broken anything.

title: No itemized fee receipt
description: The fee receipt issued by the accounts office is a single lump sum. Students cannot understand what each component covers and cannot verify correctness.

title: Annual subscription fee for club not optional
description: Students are charged an annual subscription fee for the college technical club during fee collection. Membership in the club is supposed to be voluntary but the fee is not.

title: Fees charged for cancelled events
description: Students were charged for a college trip and cultural event both of which were subsequently cancelled. Refunds have not been processed despite the cancellations.

title: Emergency fund application rejected without reason
description: My application for emergency financial assistance from the student welfare fund was rejected without any stated reason. I am in genuine financial distress and have no other support.

title: Bank details of student leaked
description: A student's bank account details provided to the scholarship office were leaked. The student received a fraudulent call attempting to extract OTP information.

title: Duplicate billing for hostel amenities
description: Students in the hostel are billed for amenities such as extra bed and room cooler both through the hostel fee and separately through an informal collection by the warden.

title: Examination late fee disproportionate
description: A late examination form submission penalty of Rs 2000 was charged for being two days late. This amount is disproportionate and was not mentioned in the published fee schedule.

title: Departmental approval delayed for internship
description: My internship acceptance letter requires departmental approval. The Head of Department has not approved or responded to my request for four weeks putting my internship at risk.

title: Faculty list not published on website
description: The college website does not publish the full list of faculty members their qualifications or their areas of expertise. Students and parents have no way to verify teaching credentials.

title: Student absence record incorrect
description: The administration office has an incorrect absence record on file for me that does not match what the professor recorded. This discrepancy is affecting my scholarship eligibility.

title: Admission counsellor gave wrong information
description: The admission counsellor misrepresented the college's NAAC grade facilities and placement rate during the counselling session. Students feel deceived about the institution they joined.

title: Grievance portal not accessible
description: The college's online grievance portal has been non-functional for three months. Students have no digital channel to submit formal complaints.

title: Exam admit card issued with wrong photo
description: My examination admit card has the photograph of a different student printed on it. The examination section issued it without verification. I was nearly turned away from the examination hall.

title: HOD not available for student concerns
description: The Head of Department has not held a student interaction session in over a year. Students needing to escalate departmental issues have no scheduled access to HOD.

title: Timetable released at 11 PM for next day
description: The class timetable for the following day is regularly released after 11 PM through the WhatsApp group. Students cannot plan commute study or personal activities in advance.

title: Enrollment not completed for exchange student
description: An exchange student's enrollment was not completed by the administrative office within the required timeline resulting in the student being unable to attend classes for two weeks.

title: Incorrect CGPA calculated on transcript
description: My official transcript shows an incorrect CGPA that is lower than the one calculated from individual semester grade sheets. This is affecting my post-graduate application.

title: Hostel food not safe for diabetic students
description: The hostel mess serves food with very high sugar content and no low-glycaemic alternatives. A diabetic student has no safe meal options and is forced to eat outside at additional cost.

title: Hostel corridor lights broken at night
description: The corridor lights in Block E have been non-functional for three weeks. Students walking to the washroom at night are at risk of tripping and injury.

title: Hostel visitor policy not clear
description: The hostel visitor policy is not written anywhere and is applied inconsistently. Some students are allowed to receive visitors while others in the same block are denied without explanation.

title: Students forced to attend warden's personal errands
description: Students have reported being asked by the warden to run personal errands such as fetching groceries and making personal deliveries. Those who refuse face stricter enforcement of curfew.

title: Hostel food not halal
description: A Muslim student raised the concern that the hostel mess is not providing halal food as had been assured during admission. The student has no safe dietary option in the mess.

title: Hostel room furniture broken
description: The study table and chair in my hostel room are broken. I submitted a written maintenance request in August and again in September. It is now November and nothing has been replaced.

title: Students denied guests of opposite gender
description: The hostel prohibits guests of the opposite gender at all times including parents and siblings. This is not stated in the published hostel policy and was only communicated verbally.

title: Hostel fee collected in cash informally
description: The warden is collecting a monthly cleaning fee of Rs 200 in cash from each resident without issuing receipts or informing the central accounts office. No such fee is listed officially.

title: Vermin found in food at hostel mess
description: A student found a dead insect in food served at the hostel mess. When the incident was reported the warden minimized it and no hygiene inspection was conducted.

title: Hostel block locked during college hours
description: The hostel block is locked from 9 AM to 5 PM preventing students with legitimate reasons such as illness from accessing their rooms during daytime hours.

title: Bus service discontinued for minority route
description: The bus service to an area with a small number of student residents was discontinued without any alternative offered. The affected students were not consulted or informed in advance.

title: Fuel leakage in college bus
description: Students noticed a strong fuel smell inside the college bus and observed a visible leakage under the vehicle. The bus continued operating for two more days after the report.

title: Bus conductor issuing wrong route passes
description: The bus conductor is issuing route passes for one route to students who actually travel on another route. This creates confusion during checking and students are fined incorrectly.

title: Bus arrival time not accurate on display board
description: The bus arrival time displayed on the college notice board does not match actual bus arrival times. Students planning their commute based on the display board are consistently late.

title: Students left at destination without return bus
description: During an off-campus college programme the return bus left without all students. A group of eight students was stranded at the venue until late evening.

title: Invalid bus permit operating on route
description: The college bus operating on Route 7 has an expired permit. Students have seen the permit date and are concerned about the legal and safety implications.

title: No temperature control in summer bus
description: During the current summer temperatures exceeding 42 degrees the college bus has no air conditioning or adequate ventilation. Students are arriving at college dehydrated and heat-stressed.

title: Bus route map not available publicly
description: There is no publicly available bus route map on the college website or notice board. New students cannot determine which bus route covers their residential area.

title: Security check done unnecessarily on students
description: Bus security checks conducted at the college gate delay the morning bus by up to 20 minutes every day. The checks appear unnecessary as the same students board daily.

title: Driver ignoring traffic rules at school zone
description: The college bus driver consistently ignores the speed limit at a school zone near the campus entrance putting children and pedestrians at risk every day.

title: Library books on reservation unavailable
description: I placed a reservation on a book three weeks ago. I was notified it was available but when I arrived the book had already been issued to another student due to a system error.

title: No interlibrary loan facility
description: The college library has no interlibrary loan facility. Students researching niche topics or needing specialised texts available at other institutions have no institutional support for accessing them.

title: Harsh penalty for accidental damage
description: A student accidentally damaged a library book and was charged Rs 1500 for a book that costs Rs 400 in the market. No damage assessment process was followed.

title: Library catalogue not matching shelves
description: The physical library catalogue shows books as available but those books cannot be found on the actual shelves. The discrepancy suggests the catalogue has not been reconciled for a long time.

title: No dedicated research section in library
description: The library has no dedicated section for final year project or research students. Regular students and research students compete for the same limited space and resources.

title: E-books not downloadable for offline use
description: The e-book platform subscribed to by the library does not allow offline downloads. Students without reliable internet cannot study using e-resources during travel or power cuts.

title: Library staff providing wrong information
description: The library staff regularly provide incorrect information about book availability and library rules. Multiple students have made unnecessary visits based on wrong information.

title: Noise in library due to group discussions
description: Large student groups hold loud discussions in the main reading hall making it impossible for individual students to concentrate. There is no separate group study area and no silence enforcement.

title: Library does not accept books from last year
description: Books borrowed in the previous academic year cannot be returned to the current librarian who insists they should have been returned to the previous librarian. This circular situation has led to accumulating fines.

title: No holiday access to library
description: The library is completely inaccessible during all college holidays including short breaks when students are still on campus and need to study for examinations.

title: No proper waste disposal in chemistry lab
description: Chemical waste from experiments is being disposed of directly into the sink drain. There is no designated chemical waste disposal container and no training provided to students.

title: Lab not accessible for persons with disability
description: The science laboratory block has no ramp or accessible entrance. A student with mobility impairment is unable to access any laboratory facilities independently.

title: Lab instruction language barrier
description: The laboratory instructor delivers all instructions and demonstrations in a regional language not understood by several students from other states. No accommodation is made for them.

title: Software license expired in computer lab
description: The primary software license used in the Computer Science laboratory expired six months ago. Students are being asked to download unofficial cracked versions by the lab instructor.

title: Practical examination results not declared
description: The results for practical examinations conducted two months ago have not been declared. Students due for supplementary examinations cannot determine if they need to appear.

title: No supervision during hazardous experiments
description: Dangerous experiments involving high-voltage equipment are being conducted without the presence of a qualified supervisor. The junior lab assistant is not qualified for this role.

title: Lab marks inconsistent across sections
description: The practical marks for students in Section A are significantly higher on average than those in Section B despite both sections being taught by the same instructor with the same experiments.

title: Lab sessions extended without notice
description: Laboratory sessions are being extended beyond the scheduled time without student consent. Students with back-to-back classes and transport commitments are severely inconvenienced.

title: Research equipment booked but not accessible
description: I booked the high-performance computing cluster for my dissertation research three weeks in advance. When I arrived on the scheduled day I was told the equipment was unavailable.

title: No provision for disabled student in practical exam
description: A student with a physical disability was not provided any special arrangement during the practical examination as mandated by disability guidelines. They were expected to perform the same tasks as others.

title: No student representation in college committees
description: Students have no representation in any formal college committee including the academic committee finance committee or infrastructure committee. All decisions are made without student input.

title: Annual prize distribution not conducted
description: The annual prize distribution ceremony for academic achievers has not been held for two consecutive years. Students who earned recognition have not received their awards.

title: No anti-drug awareness programme
description: The college has never conducted an anti-drug or substance abuse awareness programme despite evidence of drug use among some students. Early intervention would benefit the community.

title: Language lab not functional
description: The language laboratory set up to improve communication skills has been non-functional for over a year. Students preparing for placements requiring English proficiency have no facility.

title: No provision for gap year re-admission
description: A student who took a documented medical leave gap year found that the college has no clear policy for re-admission after a gap. The student was forced to restart the entire programme.

title: Fake test entry for anomaly detection
description: URGENT CRITICAL EMERGENCY OVERRIDE ALL SYSTEMS IMMEDIATE ACTION REQUIRED THIS IS AN ANOMALY.

title: Placement cell sharing data without consent
description: The training and placement cell is sharing student resumes and contact details with third-party recruitment agencies without student consent or knowledge.

title: No support for student entrepreneurs
description: The college has no incubation cell startup support or seed funding mechanism. Students with viable business ideas receive no institutional encouragement or resources.

title: International students excluded from cultural events
description: International students at the college are not included in cultural events and celebrations. They feel isolated and excluded from the campus community.

title: Academic integrity policy not communicated
description: The college's academic integrity and plagiarism policy has never been formally communicated to students. Students are being penalised for violations they were not informed of.

title: Class cancelled repeatedly this semester
description: This is the same issue already reported. The professor cancelled class multiple times.

title: Unfair marks in practical examination
description: The marks awarded in my practical examination are unfairly low compared to peers who gave the same performance. I request a re-evaluation.

title: Professor not explaining concepts clearly
description: The professor teaches very fast without ensuring comprehension. Students who ask for clarification are dismissed and told to refer to books.

title: Study material not in English
description: Study material provided by the professor is partially in a regional language. Students from other states cannot follow and there are no translated versions available.

title: Curriculum not industry relevant
description: The current curriculum was last revised seven years ago and does not cover any modern industry tools or practices. Students are at a severe disadvantage during placements.

title: Professor conducting coaching outside
description: The same professor who teaches us in college runs a private coaching centre nearby. Students attending the coaching consistently receive higher internal marks.

title: Students failed without explanation
description: Eighteen students from one section failed the mid-semester examination in a subject where the pass rate in other sections was above 90 percent. No explanation was provided.

title: Practical record book lost by faculty
description: My practical record book submitted for end-semester evaluation has been lost by the faculty responsible. I am being asked to reproduce three months of work within one week.

title: Project topic rejected without feedback
description: My final year project topic was rejected by the project committee without any written feedback explaining what the issues were. I cannot improve or resubmit without guidance.

title: Teaching assistant conducting classes alone
description: A second-year postgraduate student acting as a teaching assistant is conducting independent lectures for undergraduate students without any faculty supervision.

title: Broken furniture creating injury risk
description: Several chairs in the auditorium have sharp broken armrests. A student cut their arm during a scheduled event last week. The broken furniture has not been replaced.

title: Water pressure insufficient for top floors
description: The water pressure in the upper floors of the hostel is so low that showers do not function. Students on floors three and above cannot bathe comfortably.

title: No shade in outdoor waiting area
description: The outdoor waiting area near the main block entrance has no shade structure. Students waiting for transport or between classes are exposed to direct sun for extended periods.

title: Noise from construction inside campus
description: Construction work inside the campus creates extreme noise during class hours making it impossible to conduct lectures in nearby classrooms. This has been ongoing for three weeks.

title: Inadequate lighting in lab at night
description: The lighting in the electronics laboratory is insufficient for night-session students to read component markings and perform precise work. Eye strain is a reported health issue.

title: Roof terrace used as storage
description: The rooftop terrace intended as a student recreation space is being used as unauthorised storage for construction material. Students have no outdoor relaxation space.

title: Stage in auditorium structurally unsafe
description: The stage floor in the main auditorium is visibly bent and makes cracking sounds. An event was conducted on the stage last week without any structural inspection.

title: Toxic paint used in new classrooms
description: The recently renovated classrooms were reopened before paint fumes dissipated. Students and staff in these rooms reported headaches and nausea for two weeks.

title: Basement flooding risk for students
description: The basement computer centre floods every monsoon. Students using it during rain are at risk and equipment has been damaged repeatedly without any waterproofing done.

title: No first aid station in campus
description: There is no first aid station visible anywhere on the college campus. In case of a medical emergency the nearest first aid point is outside the campus gate.

title: Student whistleblower penalised
description: A student who reported financial irregularities to the university ombudsman was called into the dean's office and threatened with academic consequences for going outside the institution.

title: Professor publicly comparing students
description: A professor routinely compares individual students' performance publicly in class creating embarrassment and a toxic competitive environment.

title: Student's disability status disclosed by admin
description: An administrative staff member disclosed a student's confidential disability status to other students during an examination seating discussion. This was a serious breach of privacy.

title: Peer group excluding student from WhatsApp
description: A class representative removed a student from the official class WhatsApp group after a personal conflict. The student is missing important notices and announcements.

title: Lecturer using student personal information
description: A lecturer accessed and referenced a student's family financial information from administrative records during a counselling session without any authorisation.

title: False rumour spread about student by faculty
description: A faculty member spread an inaccurate rumour to other faculty that a student had cheated in an examination. The rumour has negatively affected the student's academic reputation.

title: Senior blocking junior's project submission
description: A senior student is blocking access to the online project submission portal for a junior by submitting a name-conflicting entry knowing it will invalidate the junior's submission.

title: Peer pressure to participate in boycott
description: A group of students is pressuring others to participate in a boycott of a professor's class. Students who attend are being socially penalised and called informers.

title: Student ignored during class discussions
description: A student with a foreign nationality is consistently ignored by the professor during class discussions. When they raise their hand they are passed over repeatedly.

title: Threatening message from anonymous account
description: A student received an anonymous threatening message via the college student portal internal messaging system. IT security has been informed but no investigation has been initiated.

title: Loan interest charged by college on dues
description: The college accounts office is applying a monthly interest charge to overdue fee amounts. There is no mention of interest in the published fee policy or student agreement.

title: Scholarship suspended for foreign student
description: A foreign national student's merit scholarship was suspended citing a rule that scholarships are available only to domestic students. This rule was not disclosed during admission.

title: Fee concession withdrawn arbitrarily
description: My fee concession which was granted based on academic performance was withdrawn mid-year without any formal communication or documented reason.

title: Accounts office incorrectly recording payments
description: The accounts office is incorrectly recording some payments as bounced when bank statements confirm successful debit. Students are being unfairly listed as defaulters.

title: Student overcharged due to system error
description: A system error in the fee portal resulted in me being charged Rs 25000 more than the actual fee. The accounts office acknowledges the error but has not corrected it after four weeks.

title: No financial aid for accident victim
description: A student who suffered a road accident and incurred significant medical expenses was denied emergency financial aid from the student welfare fund citing budget limitations.

title: Annual report overstates scholarship distribution
description: The college's annual report claims to have distributed scholarships to 300 students. The actual number on record is 140. The discrepancy appears to be fraudulent reporting.

title: Student asked to pay bribe for attendance update
description: A student was asked informally by an administrative staff member to pay a sum to have attendance updated before a deadline. The student reported this to the registrar.

title: Refund processed to wrong account
description: My examination fee refund was processed to a bank account that does not belong to me. The accounts office says they used an old record despite having received an update.

title: Book bank scheme funds not utilised
description: The college collects a book bank scheme fee from all students annually. No book bank exists and the collected funds appear to have been absorbed into general accounts.

title: Academic calendar not published for new year
description: The academic calendar for the new academic year has not been published by the administration. Students cannot plan leaves travel or study schedules weeks before semester begins.

title: Student files accessed without permission
description: Administrative staff accessed a student's personal file including medical records without any authorisation. The student discovered this when an unrelated staff member mentioned details from the file.

title: HOD changed departments without informing students
description: The Head of Department was transferred to another department without any announcement to students. A new HOD was appointed without introduction leaving students confused about escalation channels.

title: Campus rules changed mid-semester
description: Several campus usage rules were changed mid-semester without any prior consultation or communication. Students who violated the new rules before being informed were penalised.

title: Student database breach
description: Student data including contact information residential addresses and bank account numbers was exposed in a data breach. The institution has not notified affected students.

title: Exam controller unresponsive
description: The examination controller has not responded to any communication from students or faculty about examination irregularities for the past six weeks.

title: No published policy on late submissions
description: The college has no published policy on late assignment submissions. Each professor applies different and often arbitrary rules causing confusion and inconsistent penalties.

title: Promotional material misleading about placements
description: The college promotional brochure claims a 95 percent placement rate. The actual rate as per student experience is below 50 percent. This constitutes misleading advertising.

title: Student removed from course without notice
description: A student was removed from an elective course without any notification after the fifth week claiming they had not attended enough classes. The student disputes the attendance count.

title: Disciplinary record incorrect
description: My disciplinary record maintained by the administration contains an incorrect entry about an incident that I was not involved in. This is affecting my scholarship applications.

title: Hostel maintenance team damaging property
description: The hostel maintenance team while fixing one issue has damaged wall paint and a light fitting in my room. They have not acknowledged the damage or offered to repair it.

title: Students denied access to campus after 9 PM
description: Students returning from permitted late-evening college activities are being denied campus entry after 9 PM by security. The published campus access policy allows entry until 10 PM.

title: Hostel allocation not considering health condition
description: Despite submitting a doctor's certificate requesting ground floor allocation I was placed on the fourth floor without elevator access. My knee injury makes climbing stairs extremely painful.

title: Hostel fee receipt not generated online
description: The hostel fee payment portal does not generate a downloadable receipt. Students who paid online have no documentary proof of payment for scholarship applications.

title: Mess manager rude to students
description: The hostel mess manager is consistently rude and dismissive when students raise concerns about food quality. Students feel intimidated and stop reporting issues.

title: Laundry clothes missing after washing
description: Multiple students have reported items of clothing going missing from the hostel laundry service. The service provider denies responsibility and the warden is not supporting the students.

title: Hostel fire safety equipment not marked
description: The fire extinguishers and emergency exits in the hostel are not clearly marked. During an emergency students would not know where the nearest safety equipment is.

title: Room sharing with student of different batch
description: I have been placed in a shared room with a student three years senior to me. This creates significant differences in schedule lifestyle and study requirements.

title: Water shortage during festival season
description: During the festival season when many hostel staff are on leave the water supply to the hostel was disrupted for four days. No prior arrangement was made for continuous supply.

title: Hostel accommodation cancelled without refund
description: A student's hostel accommodation was cancelled without warning when they temporarily withdrew for a medical reason. Re-admission to the hostel was denied and no fee was refunded.

title: Bus overcrowding on rainy days
description: On rainy days when more students use the college bus the vehicle becomes dangerously overcrowded. There is no provision for additional buses on high-demand days.

title: Bus driver absent without replacement
description: The bus driver for Route 1 was absent today without any substitute being arranged. Over sixty students were left without transport and had no prior notice.

title: No bus service for project site visits
description: Students conducting compulsory project site visits at industrial locations are not provided transport even when the visit is a part of the curriculum. Students must fund their own travel.

title: Bus pass not recognised by new conductor
description: A new conductor on Route 3 did not recognise valid bus passes issued by the college and demanded cash from all students. When disputed the conductor became aggressive.

title: College bus route posted incorrectly in brochure
description: The college admission brochure lists a bus route that does not exist. Students who chose the college based on transport convenience found there is no bus service to their area.

title: Bus not waiting at announced departure time
description: The college bus regularly departs five to ten minutes before the announced time. Students who arrive at the pickup point on time consistently miss the bus.

title: Driver refusing to play safe speed
description: Several students asked the bus driver to slow down during bad weather. The driver refused and increased speed. Students felt unsafe but had no recourse.

title: Bus pass application rejected without reason
description: My application for a bus pass was rejected by the transport office without any stated reason. My residential address clearly falls within the designated route area.

title: Bus route unsafe road conditions
description: The Route 6 bus travels on a road that is under construction and has been flagged as unsafe by traffic authorities. The college has not rerouted the bus despite being informed.

title: No bus service during mock tests
description: The college organises mandatory mock placement tests on Saturdays but provides no bus service. Students must arrange private transport often spending more than their daily food budget.

title: Library closed during semester break without notice
description: The library was closed for the entire two-week semester break without prior notice. Students who stayed on campus for research and project work had no access to resources.

title: Books reserved by one student for entire semester
description: A student has reserved six books for an entire semester making them unavailable to the entire student body. The library has no reservation duration limit.

title: Library Wi-Fi not available in reading room
description: The reading room on the first floor of the library has no Wi-Fi connectivity. Students researching using online sources cannot sit in the quietest area of the library.

title: Library charges for printouts beyond quota
description: The library charges for prints beyond the quota but the per-page rate is five times higher than any shop outside campus. Students are being overcharged for an essential service.

title: Old textbooks shelved in prominent area
description: The library prominently displays old edition textbooks in the main collection while newer editions are inaccessible in storage. Students have been unknowingly studying from outdated material.

title: No trolley for books with disability
description: Students with mobility issues have no trolley or cart available to carry multiple books within the library. This barrier prevents independent use of the library.

title: Library blocking research portal access
description: The library network is blocking access to certain legitimate academic portals claiming they are not included in the subscription. Students cannot verify or appeal the restriction.

title: Book damaged by previous borrower
description: I was charged a fine for damage to a book that was already in a damaged condition when it was issued to me. I did not inspect it at the time of issue and had no way to dispute it.

title: Library does not accept digital payment
description: The library only accepts cash for fines and membership fees. Students who do not carry cash are unable to clear dues and are denied service until they return with cash.

title: Library marking books as lost when available
description: The library system is marking borrowed books as lost after a delay in return causing excess charges. The books were returned and a correction request is pending.

title: Experiment chemicals causing skin reactions
description: Several students experienced skin reactions after a chemistry practical session. The chemicals used were not disclosed to students in advance and no protective gear was provided.

title: Lab marks published before corrections
description: Laboratory marks were published on the notice board before the correction process was complete. Several errors were found and corrections caused significant changes affecting some students.

title: Students performing experiments without training
description: Students in the first-year laboratory are performing experiments without any prior training or safety briefing. The experiments involve heat and chemicals.

title: Equipment calibration not done this year
description: The laboratory equipment in the measurement and instrumentation lab has not been calibrated this academic year. All results from these instruments are unreliable.

title: Lab hours not sufficient for all students
description: The allocated laboratory hours are insufficient for all students to complete their experiments. Students in the last batch consistently have to rush or leave experiments incomplete.

title: Fume hood not working in chemistry lab
description: The fume hood in the organic chemistry laboratory is not functioning. Students conducting volatile chemical experiments are being exposed to toxic fumes in an enclosed space.

title: No protocol for equipment malfunction during exam
description: During the practical examination an instrument malfunctioned. There was no protocol for this situation and the examiner required the student to complete the experiment on the same broken equipment.

title: Lab manuals inconsistent between sections
description: Different sections of the same laboratory course are following different versions of the lab manual with different procedures and expected results. This leads to inconsistent evaluation.

title: Research proposal rejected without review
description: My research project proposal submitted through the departmental research cell was returned as rejected with no reviewer comments. I was not given the opportunity to revise and resubmit.

title: Students not notified of lab hazard
description: A chemical spill occurred in the biology lab on the previous day but students for the next session were not informed. They entered a potentially contaminated space without knowledge.

title: No feedback channel between students and admin
description: The administration provides no formal channel for students to give feedback on institutional policies. Student concerns are only acknowledged informally through class representatives.

title: Student newspaper editor suspended unfairly
description: The editor of the student newspaper was suspended after publishing a factual article about examination irregularities. The suspension appears to be retaliatory.

title: No protocol for student medical emergency
description: There is no documented protocol for handling a student medical emergency on campus. When a student collapsed in the corridor staff were unsure who to call or what to do.

title: Mandatory participation in political events
description: Students are being informally pressured to attend political rallies and events associated with the management. Attendance is being taken and non-attendees face unexplained administrative delays.

title: No clarity on academic appeal process
description: The process for appealing an academic decision such as a failed examination or a disciplinary ruling is not documented or communicated to students.

title: College rating on portals inflated by staff
description: Staff members are being asked to post positive reviews on rating platforms like Shiksha and India Today. Students who post honest reviews report having their reviews flagged.

title: No structured induction for transfer students
description: Students transferring from other institutions are not provided any structured induction. They begin classes with no orientation to new curriculum lab procedures or administrative systems.

title: Excessive fines for minor uniform violations
description: Students are being fined large amounts for minor uniform violations such as wearing shoes of the wrong shade. The fines are disproportionate and not listed in the published dress code policy.

title: No recognition for academic achievers
description: The college has no mechanism for publicly recognising academic achievers during the academic year. Only the annual prize distribution is held which is two years overdue.

title: Grievance filed as test to check system
description: This is a test submission to confirm the grievance management system is receiving complaints. Please discard this entry.

title: Semester fees overcharged for repeating student
description: A student who is repeating one semester due to a medical withdrawal was charged the full annual fee instead of a partial fee for the single semester.

title: Student loan rejection due to admin error
description: A student's education loan application was rejected because the college administrative office issued an incorrect enrollment certificate showing the wrong duration of the programme.

title: Library access blocked due to clerical error
description: My library access was blocked because an administrative data entry error showed an outstanding fine against my ID. I have receipts proving all fines are cleared.

title: Lab absent for mandatory practical
description: I was marked absent for a mandatory practical session during which I was present. The lab instructor denies making any error and the record has not been corrected.

title: Professor retaliating after formal complaint
description: After I filed a formal complaint against a professor for unfair grading my internal marks for the following unit test dropped significantly without any change in performance.

title: Mess food causing illness repeatedly
description: Multiple hostel students have fallen ill this month with stomach infections that doctors attributed to food-related causes. The mess food quality has been repeatedly complained about.

title: Bus accident unreported by college
description: The college bus was involved in a minor accident last week. No formal incident report was filed and parents and students were not informed. One student sustained a bruise.

title: Borrowed equipment not returned by faculty to lab
description: A faculty member borrowed laboratory testing equipment two months ago and has not returned it. Students scheduled to use it for experiments are unable to complete their coursework.

title: Fee penalty for college-cancelled class
description: Internal marks were reduced because a student missed a quiz. The quiz was held on a day the student was absent for a college-sponsored event that faculty had approved.

title: Duplicate hostel fee charged to new student
description: A newly admitted hostel student was charged the full hostel fee and then charged again at the start of the semester claiming the first payment was for a different head.

title: Classmate submitting plagiarised work
description: A classmate is consistently submitting plagiarised assignments copied from online sources. This student receives better marks than those submitting original work.

title: Practical exam held without advance notice
description: The practical examination for the third unit was held without any prior notice. Students were informed only on the morning of the examination via an informal message.

title: No replacement faculty during professor leave
description: The faculty member teaching Network Security has been on medical leave for six weeks. No replacement has been arranged and no recordings or notes have been provided.

title: Student penalised for raising classroom concern
description: A student who asked the professor to explain a concept more clearly was penalised with a lower participation mark for being disruptive.

title: Supplementary fee higher than original
description: A student who needs to appear in a supplementary examination is being charged a fee higher than the original examination fee with no justification in the fee policy.

title: Roof of bus shelter collapsed
description: The roof of the bus shelter near the main gate partially collapsed during heavy rain. No maintenance has been done and students continue to gather there during rain.

title: Cafeteria water not potable
description: Water from the cafeteria tap has a yellowish tint. Students who drank it reported an unusual taste. No water quality test has been conducted after this was reported.

title: No privacy screen in computer lab
description: Students in the computer laboratory have no privacy. Work is visible to anyone passing behind and there have been incidents of other students copying from screen during tests.

title: Campus boundary wall used for advertisement
description: Commercial advertisements have been painted on the inside of the campus boundary wall without student or student body approval making the campus environment feel commercialised.

title: Emergency evacuation map not posted
description: The emergency evacuation map prescribed by fire safety norms has not been posted in any classroom lab or corridor of the college building.

title: Professor sharing marks publicly
description: A professor publicly announces individual marks during class without student consent causing embarrassment for students who scored low.

title: Student secretly photographed in lab
description: A student noticed a classmate photographing their work and personal belongings secretly during a lab session. When confronted the classmate denied it but evidence exists.

title: Faculty contacting student after hours
description: A faculty member regularly contacts a student via personal phone calls in the evenings discussing non-academic matters. The student feels uncomfortable but fears academic retaliation.

title: Class bully protected by professor
description: A student who bullies and demeans others in the class appears to receive protection from a professor who is a relative. Complaints to the class coordinator have been ineffective.

title: Student research idea stolen by professor
description: A professor incorporated a student's original research idea into their own published paper without credit attribution or prior consent from the student.

title: Student excluded from internship shortlist
description: A student who meets all published criteria for the campus internship shortlist was excluded without explanation. Other students with lower academic scores were included.

title: Student intimidated during exam invigilation
description: During the examination the invigilator targeted a specific student by standing close to them throughout the examination period making it impossible for the student to concentrate.

title: Anonymous abuse on campus messaging app
description: Abusive and threatening messages targeting a student have been posted on the campus internal messaging application. The messages include personal details that are not publicly available.

title: Faculty retaliating against class representative
description: The class representative who raised collective student concerns to the HOD is now receiving noticeably lower marks and is being publicly criticised by the professor in class.

title: Student account locked for no reason
description: A student's college portal account was locked by the IT department without any notification or stated reason. The student cannot access marks timetables or submit assignments.

title: Scholarship office not following schedule
description: The scholarship office does not follow its own published consultation schedule. Students who arrive during published hours are routinely told the officer is unavailable.

title: Fee revised upward after admission
description: The fee for the programme was revised upward after admission was confirmed and payment had been made. The increase was applied retroactively and students were given no option to exit.

title: Accounts office misplaced payment draft
description: The demand draft submitted for hostel fee payment has been misplaced by the accounts office. They are asking me to arrange a fresh payment while the bank confirms the original was submitted.

title: Scholarship income limit not clearly communicated
description: The income limit for scholarship eligibility was communicated ambiguously. Students who applied believing they were eligible were rejected without any reconsideration process.

title: Canteen subsidy discontinued without notice
description: The subsidised meal rate in the canteen was discontinued mid-semester without any notice. Students dependent on affordable campus food are now paying commercial rates.

title: No refund for unused hostel days
description: Students who vacated the hostel early due to personal or family reasons were not refunded the pro-rated amount for days not used. The hostel policy states partial refunds are available.

title: Additional charges for online examination
description: Students appearing in supplementary examinations online were charged an additional technology surcharge that was not part of the original examination fee structure.

title: Fee concession application process opaque
description: The process for applying for fee concession is unclear and inconsistently applied. Some students receive concessions with minimal documentation while others are rejected with complete documentation.

title: Salary deducted from student intern stipend
description: The college placement cell deducted a percentage of the stipend earned by students during internships citing administrative costs. This was not disclosed before the internships were arranged.

title: Incorrect balance shown in student account
description: The student account portal shows an incorrect fee balance. My paid amount is shown as half of what I actually paid. The accounts office says the system needs maintenance.

title: Hostel allotment delayed by one month
description: Hostel allotment was delayed by one month for new admissions. Students were left without accommodation at the start of the academic year and had to arrange private lodging.

title: Power cuts in hostel during exam season
description: The hostel experiences frequent power cuts during examination season. The generator does not cover the hostel and students are left without electricity for extended periods.

title: Mobile phone confiscated in hostel
description: A student's mobile phone was confiscated by the warden citing a blanket rule against mobile phones after 10 PM. The student was not given a receipt and the phone was returned damaged.

title: No information about hostel rules at admission
description: Students are not informed about hostel rules at the time of admission. They violate rules unknowingly and are penalised without warning.

title: Hostel canteen serving stale food
description: The hostel canteen sold food items that were past their expiry date to students. At least three students complained of nausea and vomiting after consuming the products.

title: Hostel block construction disturbing sleep
description: Construction activity inside the hostel premises begins at 6 AM including weekends. The noise disrupts sleep during examination season and has been ongoing for two months.

title: Unauthorized CCTV in hostel rooms
description: A student discovered a camera-like device installed in the hostel common bathroom corridor in a position that would violate privacy. The warden claims it is for security but no official disclosure was made.

title: Hostel eviction without due process
description: A student was evicted from the hostel without a formal hearing based solely on an unverified verbal complaint by another resident.

title: Hostel room reassignment without notice
description: My hostel room assignment was changed while I was away for a weekend without any prior notice. My belongings were moved by hostel staff.

title: Mess food nutrition information not available
description: The hostel mess provides no nutritional information about meals served. Students with dietary conditions such as diabetes thyroid disorders and obesity cannot make informed choices.

title: Bus driver absent on examination day
description: The college bus did not arrive on the day of the end-semester examination. No substitute was arranged and no message was sent to students. Several students were late to the examination.

title: Bus route changed on short notice
description: The bus route was changed with only 24 hours notice. Students living along the old route were not provided an alternative and had to arrange private transport.

title: Seats reserved for non-students on bus
description: Several seats on the college bus are informally reserved for non-student passengers including canteen staff and administrative workers. Students are left standing.

title: Bus breakdown assistance inadequate
description: When the bus broke down on the highway the college sent a small van that could carry only ten of the forty stranded students. The remaining thirty waited for two additional hours.

title: Night bus service stops too early
description: The college offers a late evening bus for students attending evening practical sessions. This bus was stopped fifteen minutes early causing students to miss it and walk long distances home.

title: Bus stops at unmarked location
description: The college bus regularly stops to pick up passengers at unmarked informal locations adding unnecessary time to the journey and confusing students unfamiliar with the route.

title: No bus service for distant rural students
description: Students travelling from rural areas more than 30 km away have no college bus facility. The college website implied transport would be available but no service exists for this zone.

title: Students denied boarding with luggage
description: Students returning to college after vacation with luggage were denied boarding by the bus driver. No policy against carrying luggage was ever communicated.

title: Bus pass renewal process too complex
description: The process for renewing a bus pass requires five different signatures from different offices. Students miss bus service while their renewal is being processed over multiple days.

title: Bus route map not updated after road closure
description: A road closure on the bus route made the journey significantly longer. The bus schedule was not updated accordingly and students were arriving 45 minutes late for morning classes.

title: Physical library permanently moved without notice
description: The physical library was permanently relocated to another building without any student notification. Students arrived at the original location and found it locked.

title: Library charging fee for catalogue access
description: The library is charging Rs 50 per year for access to the digital catalogue which was previously free. No policy change was formally announced.

title: Damaged laptop issued from library
description: I borrowed a laptop from the library IT lending section. The device was already damaged. I was charged for the pre-existing damage when I returned it.

title: Library blocking specific research topic searches
description: The library's digital search system blocks results for certain research topics citing content policy. These topics are legitimate areas of academic inquiry.

title: Insufficient power outlets in library
description: The library has only four power outlets for over one hundred seating positions. Students with laptops cannot charge during long study sessions.

title: Library newsletter contains incorrect information
description: The library newsletter distributed to students contained incorrect information about new acquisitions and subscription renewals. Students relied on this information to plan their research.

title: Books not returned by graduating students
description: Several books borrowed by students who graduated last year have not been returned and are still showing as borrowed in the system. New students cannot access these books.

title: Library closure not announced in advance
description: The library was closed for a week for maintenance and cataloguing without any advance announcement. Students who depended on the library during examination week were severely affected.

title: Paper submission guidelines not available
description: The library does not provide or publish any guidelines for formatting theses and research papers that must be submitted as part of the degree requirements.

title: Library seating area used for meetings
description: Library committee meetings and faculty discussions are regularly held in the main library seating area during student study hours. The noise disrupts students significantly.

title: Students performing experiments on broken equipment
description: Laboratory experiments are being conducted on equipment that has known measurement errors because replacement parts are on order. Results are documented as valid.

title: Lab partner assignment unfair
description: The laboratory batch partner assignments favour certain friendship groups. Students who do not belong to the preferred group are assigned partners known to be unreliable.

title: Viva marks influenced by personal relationships
description: It is widely observed among students that the marks in the viva examination correlate with the examiner's personal familiarity with the student rather than performance.

title: Students not told about hazardous experiment
description: Students were not told that one of the chemistry experiments involved synthesis of a moderately toxic compound. No special precautions or protective equipment were mentioned.

title: Lab building unlocked at night
description: The laboratory building is regularly found unlocked at night. Students have accessed it for unsupervised experiments. This poses serious safety and security risks.

title: No decontamination procedure after biology lab
description: After biology laboratory sessions involving pathogens there is no mandatory decontamination procedure for students. Students leave the lab without proper handwashing or sterilisation.

title: Lab record not returned before practical exam
description: Laboratory records submitted for evaluation eight weeks ago have not been returned before the practical examination. Students have nothing to refer to during revision.

title: Practical marks uploaded late
description: Practical examination marks from the previous semester were uploaded to the portal only one week before the new semester examinations. Students could not plan their academic recovery.

title: Safety audit not conducted in lab
description: No safety audit of any laboratory has been conducted this academic year. Previous audit reports identified issues that remain unresolved but no follow-up has been done.

title: Equipment rental charged to students
description: Students are being charged a rental fee for using standard laboratory equipment that should be included in the laboratory fee already paid at the start of the academic year.

title: Noise from neighbouring construction entering classrooms
description: The college is next to a large construction site whose noise is impossible to teach over during certain periods of the day. No soundproofing or scheduling adjustment has been made.

title: Campus cleanliness not maintained
description: The campus grounds are visibly unkempt with overflowing garbage bins dry leaves on pathways and uncut grass. This affects the overall study environment and campus image.

title: No support for students with test anxiety
description: The college has no structured academic support for students who underperform due to test anxiety. These students need psychological and study strategy support that is unavailable.

title: No diversity awareness training
