description: The college has never organised any diversity inclusion or cultural sensitivity training for students or faculty. Incidents of discrimination are not contextualised or addressed systemically.

title: Animal cruelty near college hostel
description: Students have observed a group of individuals near the college hostel boundary harming stray animals. College security has been informed but has not intervened or contacted animal welfare.

title: Canteen operated by personal connection
description: The canteen contract was given to a vendor connected to the college management without any tendering process. The food quality is poor and prices are higher than market rate.

title: No recognition for students helping community
description: Students who participated in an NGO-sponsored community service initiative during term time were penalised for absences instead of being given credit.

title: Energy consumption not sustainable
description: The college uses enormous amounts of single-use plastic and has no recycling programme. Several students have raised sustainability concerns that have been completely ignored.

title: Student hurt in unauthorised sport activity
description: A student was injured during an informal sporting event on campus. The event was organised by students without official permission. The college has no liability coverage for this.

title: No academic support for working students
description: Students who also work part-time to fund their education receive no flexibility in attendance assignment deadlines or examination scheduling.

title: Attendance threshold too high
description: The 85 percent attendance threshold is too high and does not account for genuine medical emergencies travel difficulties and family obligations. Multiple students are being barred from exams.

title: Professor giving marks based on class participation
description: Internal marks are heavily influenced by class participation. Students with social anxiety or those who are shy are systematically disadvantaged by this approach.

title: Online exam link shared one hour before
description: The link for the online unit test was shared only one hour before the examination. Students in areas with poor connectivity could not prepare or access the link in time.

title: Exam paper same as last year
description: The end-semester examination question paper is identical to the paper from the previous academic year. Students who had solved last year's paper answered without learning.

title: Academic advisor not assigned
description: I have been in the college for two semesters but no academic advisor has been assigned to me. I have had no formal academic guidance during this time.

title: Professor teaching wrong subject
description: The professor currently teaching Advanced Algorithms has a background in Civil Engineering. The mismatch between expertise and subject is immediately apparent from the quality of instruction.

title: Seminar marks not disclosed
description: Marks for the mandatory seminar presentation conducted three months ago have not been disclosed to students. No feedback was given and the marks are not visible on the portal.

title: Academic performance data shared with outsiders
description: A student's academic performance data was shared with an external recruitment agency without the student's consent. The student found out when contacted by the agency.

title: Plagiarism software not accessible to students
description: The college uses plagiarism detection software for final submissions but does not provide students access to verify their own work before submission.

title: Curriculum review not including students
description: The curriculum review committee meeting conducted last month did not include any student representatives. Changes to the curriculum directly affecting students were made without input.

title: Hostel curfew violated by warden's relatives
description: The hostel warden allows his own family members and friends to stay overnight in the hostel without registration while enforcing strict rules on students.

title: Hostel room not cleaned before new occupant
description: The hostel room assigned to me was not cleaned or inspected before my arrival. The previous occupant had left belongings behind and the room was unhygienic.

title: Warden using hostel resources personally
description: The warden is observed using hostel cleaning staff and supplies for personal quarters located adjacent to the hostel premises.

title: No emergency contact list in hostel
description: There is no list of emergency contacts posted in the hostel premises. In case of a fire medical emergency or security incident students do not know who to contact.

title: Students sharing single room with strangers
description: Students admitted to the hostel late in the semester are being placed in single-occupancy rooms already occupied by another student without consent from either party.

title: Hostel internet used for surveillance
description: There are reports that student internet usage within the hostel is being monitored and that browsing history is being reviewed by hostel staff for disciplinary purposes.

title: No waste segregation in hostel
description: The hostel has no waste segregation system. Wet and dry waste are mixed together making it impossible to recycle and creating persistent pest problems.

title: Noise at night from hostel management gatherings
description: College management and trust members regularly hold late-night gatherings in the hostel garden area creating noise that disrupts sleeping students.

title: Hostel sick room not stocked
description: The hostel has a designated sick room but it is not stocked with any medicine first aid supplies or basic equipment. Students who fall ill have no immediate care available.

title: Warden entering female hostel rooms without permission
description: Male maintenance staff and the warden enter female hostel rooms without advance notice or female staff presence. This is a serious violation of privacy and safety.

title: No bus for sports team matches
description: The college sports team travels to inter-college matches without any college-provided transport. Players must arrange their own travel at personal expense.

title: Bus driver discriminating against certain students
description: Students from a particular community feel the bus driver is rude and dismissive specifically toward them while being polite to others.

title: Bus schedule not accounting for traffic
description: The bus schedule was created without accounting for peak traffic hours. Buses that are scheduled to arrive on time consistently arrive 30 to 40 minutes late during peak hours.

title: Bus inspector harassing students
description: The bus inspector performing regular checks is making unreasonable demands from students and has been reported to confiscate valid passes and demand re-issuance fees.

title: No accessible transport for disabled students
description: There are no low-floor buses or accessible vehicles for students with mobility impairments. The college has never addressed this despite having enrolled students who use wheelchairs.

title: Route 8 bus carrying contraband
description: Students on Route 8 observed the bus driver allowing cartons of unidentified goods to be loaded and transported on the bus. This is an unauthorised use of college transport.

title: Bus schedule released after semester start
description: The bus schedule for the current semester was released five days after classes began. Students had no way to plan their commute for the first week.

title: Students dropped at wrong location
description: The bus driver dropped students at the wrong location during an off-campus event. Students had to navigate an unfamiliar area without college staff assistance.

title: Driver sleeping during rest stop
description: During an outstation trip the bus driver fell asleep during a rest stop and students could not continue their journey for two hours with no staff member able to drive.

title: No student transport for research field work
description: Students conducting mandatory field research as part of their dissertation receive no transport support despite the fieldwork being a degree requirement.

title: E-resources portal expired without renewal
description: The institutional subscription to the EBSCO and JSTOR databases expired and was not renewed at the start of the academic year. Students have been unable to access these resources for months.

title: Library staff distributing wrong books
description: Due to a cataloguing error books are being placed on wrong shelves and library staff continue to issue wrong books to students. Several students have only discovered the error at home.

title: Book reservation cancelled without notice
description: My reservation for an important textbook was cancelled without any notification. When I arrived to collect the book the librarian said it had been issued to someone else.

title: No procedure for reporting damaged books
description: When I received a book in damaged condition I asked for a procedure to report it at the time of borrowing. No such procedure exists and I was told to simply return it later.

title: Library restricting access near exam time
description: Library access is being restricted to final-year students only during examination preparation weeks. Lower year students with equally urgent research needs are being denied entry.

title: Project reports stolen from library archive
description: Final-year project reports submitted to the library archive are being accessed and copied by students from other batches without authorisation.

title: Research paper submission guideline changed
description: The guideline for thesis format and reference style was changed one month before submission deadline. Students who had been working to the previous format must now redo their formatting.

title: Library scanner not functional
description: The only document scanner in the library has been out of service for three weeks. Students who need to scan pages from reference books for remote research cannot do so.

title: No study pods for solo learners
description: The library has only group tables with no individual study pods or partitioned areas for students who need isolation from group noise to concentrate.

title: Newspaper archive access restricted
description: The newspaper archive containing editions from the past decade has been locked and access requires special permission that takes weeks to obtain. This is hindering current affairs research.

title: Hazardous vapours from renovation in lab block
description: The laboratory block is being renovated using solvents that produce strong vapours. Students in adjacent labs are being exposed to these chemicals during active practical sessions.

title: Student injured due to broken lab stool
description: A student was injured when a broken laboratory stool gave way during a session. The stool had a visible crack that had been reported two weeks earlier.

title: Insufficient sockets in computer lab
description: The computer lab has fewer power sockets than workstations. Students using personal laptops must share extension cords creating a tangled hazard on the floor.

title: Biology lab specimens not labelled
description: Preserved specimens in the biology laboratory are not labelled. Students preparing for the practical examination cannot identify which specimen corresponds to which organism.

title: Cold storage in chemistry lab not working
description: The cold storage unit in the chemistry laboratory where temperature-sensitive reagents should be stored is not functioning. Reagents may have degraded affecting experimental outcomes.

title: Lab ventilation fans not working
description: The ventilation fans in the electronics laboratory have not been functional for over a month. The room temperature becomes uncomfortable for students during three-hour sessions.

title: No inventory system in lab
description: There is no formal inventory system for laboratory consumables. This results in shortages during practical sessions when materials run out mid-experiment without warning.

title: Practical exam conducted in broken lab
description: The practical examination was conducted in a laboratory where three out of eight workstations were not functioning. Students assigned to broken stations were at a severe disadvantage.

title: Lab safety poster outdated
description: The laboratory safety posters on display are from ten years ago and reference chemicals and procedures that are no longer used. Current students are following outdated safety guidance.

title: Network lab switches not configured
description: The switches in the networking laboratory are factory-default and have not been configured for the experiments in the curriculum. Students cannot conduct meaningful practical exercises.

title: Examination seating plan not disclosed
description: The examination seating plan is not disclosed to students in advance. Students arrive at the examination hall and must locate their seat number from a posted list under time pressure.

title: No student lounge near examination centre
description: There is no student lounge or waiting area near the examination centre. Students who arrive early must wait outside in the sun or find seating elsewhere.

title: Mobile signal jammer affecting emergency calls
description: The mobile signal jammer installed in the examination centre is affecting phone signal in adjacent areas including the medical room. Students in emergencies cannot call for help.

title: No formal recognition for volunteer work
description: Students who dedicate significant time to approved volunteer and community service activities receive no academic credit recognition or formal acknowledgment from the institution.

title: No peer mentoring programme for new students
description: The college has no peer mentoring programme. First-year students have no seniors assigned to guide them through academic and administrative processes.

title: College letterhead being misused
description: Unofficial documents using the college letterhead and seal are being circulated. This has led to confusion among employers and other institutions receiving fraudulent documents.

title: No diversity cell in college
description: There is no diversity equity and inclusion cell in the college. Issues of discrimination faced by students from minority backgrounds have no institutional mechanism to be addressed.

title: College band forced to perform for free
description: The college music band members are regularly required to perform at management events without compensation or time off from academic commitments.

title: Student internship listings on portal are fake
description: Several internship listings posted on the college placement portal contain inaccurate company names locations and compensation details. Students have applied and been misled.

title: Teaching quality not evaluated regularly
description: The college does not conduct regular evaluations of teaching quality. Poor teaching continues without any accountability mechanism and student feedback is never acted upon.

title: Professor absent for 60% of semester
description: The professor assigned to teach Machine Learning has been present for fewer than 40% of the scheduled classes. The subject is critically important for placements.

title: Marks changed without student knowledge
description: A student discovered that their internal assessment marks were changed in the university portal between two viewing sessions without any official communication.

title: Dissertation supervisor ignoring student
description: My dissertation supervisor has not responded to a single email or meeting request in eight weeks. I am four weeks from submission and have no guidance.

title: Assignment submitted but not recorded
description: I submitted my term assignment before the deadline. The portal shows no submission and the professor says there is no record. The submission confirmation email I received is being disputed.

title: Academic probation notice without prior warning
description: I received an academic probation notice without any prior counselling or warning. The policy requires two prior warnings before probation can be imposed.

title: Online class recordings deleted
description: Online lecture recordings from the first half of the semester were deleted from the portal without any backup or notice. Students preparing for exams have lost access to these resources.

title: Exam result decimal error
description: My examination score was reported as 49.4 percent which rounds to 50 and should qualify as a pass. The system is treating it as a fail without applying standard rounding.

title: Faculty not following UGC guidelines
description: The faculty workload and teaching schedule does not follow the UGC prescribed guidelines. Several faculty are teaching significantly beyond their mandated hours which affects teaching quality.

title: Syllabus gap not addressed
description: A significant gap was identified in the syllabus coverage before the examination. Despite student representation no additional sessions were arranged and the gap was confirmed in the paper.

title: Invigilator using phone during exam
description: The invigilator during the end-semester examination was using a mobile phone throughout the session. This sets a poor example and may have compromised examination integrity.

title: Electrical shock risk from lab equipment
description: One of the power amplifiers in the electronics lab is giving mild electric shocks when touched. Two students have reported this and the equipment continues to be used.

title: Classroom temperature unbearable in summer
description: The classrooms face direct afternoon sun with no blinds or curtains. In summer months the temperature inside reaches 40 degrees Celsius during afternoon sessions.

title: Pipes burst causing flooding
description: A water pipe burst in the corridor adjacent to the server room. Water entered the server room briefly before staff intervened. IT infrastructure may have been affected.

title: Poor acoustic design in lecture hall
description: The lecture hall has terrible acoustics. Faculty at the front cannot be heard clearly at the back even with microphones. This has been an ongoing issue since the hall was constructed.

title: No natural light in basement classrooms
description: The basement classrooms used for tutorial sessions have no natural light and rely entirely on fluorescent lighting. Students spending extended periods in these rooms report eye strain.

title: External gate left open at night
description: The external campus gate is routinely left open at night after the security guard leaves their post. This is a security vulnerability that has been reported multiple times.

title: Electrical overloading in hostel corridors
description: Students in the hostel are using multiple high-wattage appliances on extension cords. The corridor electrical wiring is overloaded and the risk of a fire is significant.

title: Smoking near oxygen storage area
description: Smoking has been observed near the medical store which stocks oxygen cylinders. This combination creates an extremely serious fire and explosion risk.

title: Classroom seats not enough for all students
description: The registered strength for the class is 90 but the classroom capacity is 60. Thirty students sit on window sills floor or stand for every lecture.

title: Animal entering building through broken grill
description: A stray dog has entered the college building through a broken window grill on three occasions causing disruption to classes and raising hygiene concerns.

title: Student blackmailed using private information
description: A student is being blackmailed by a senior who claims to have personal information obtained from the student's college profile without authorisation.

title: Faculty making religious comments
description: A professor regularly makes uninvited comments on the religious practices and choices of a student in the class making the student feel singled out and unwelcome.

title: Student body shaming by peers
description: A student is being subjected to body shaming comments and jokes by classmates in both person and online. The behaviour has become systematic and the target is showing signs of distress.

title: Professor rejecting legitimate medical documentation
description: A professor is refusing to accept a medical certificate from an authorised hospital as justification for examination absence citing personal doubts about its authenticity.

title: Staff making personal comments on student clothing
description: Administrative and support staff have been making personal comments on how students dress in ways that are intrusive and not consistent with any published dress code policy.

title: Grade changed after student filed harassment complaint
description: A student who filed a harassment complaint against a professor noticed that their course grade was retroactively changed to a lower value two weeks after the complaint was filed.

title: Seniors preventing juniors from using gym equipment
description: Senior students have established an unwritten rule that juniors cannot use certain gym equipment. Juniors who attempt to do so are verbally intimidated.

title: Professor discussing student health condition publicly
description: A professor mentioned a student's chronic health condition during a class discussion about absenteeism. The student had shared this information only in a confidential counselling session.

title: False academic dishonesty charge
description: A student was charged with academic dishonesty for an assignment submission that was found similar to another student's. The student wrote original work and the similarity is coincidental.

title: Peer group sharing student's personal diary
description: Personal entries written in a notebook left in the classroom were photographed by another student and shared in the class group. The victim is extremely distressed.

title: Hostel canteen exploiting captive audience
description: The hostel canteen with no competition on campus is charging three times the market rate for essential food items. Students with no transport cannot access cheaper options.

title: Night warden missing from post
description: The night warden responsible for security between 11 PM and 6 AM is consistently absent from the duty station. Unknown individuals have been seen entering the hostel at these hours.

title: Hostel generator fuel stolen
description: Hostel residents noticed the generator ran out of fuel during a power cut. Investigation suggests the fuel was not refilled as scheduled and may have been misappropriated.

title: Hostel rules not applied equally to sports students
description: Students on the college sports team are allowed to return late bypass curfew and skip mess check-ins. The same rules are strictly enforced for non-sports students.

title: Hostel storage room accessible to all
description: The hostel storage room where confiscated items and student property are kept is not secured. Multiple students have reported items going missing from the storage.

title: Mess food inadequate for vegan students
description: There are no vegan meal options in the hostel mess. Students following a vegan diet for religious or health reasons have no viable food option within the campus.

title: Insect infestation in hostel room
description: My hostel room has a severe bed bug infestation. I reported this four weeks ago but no fumigation or room change has been arranged. My sleep is affected and I have skin reactions.

title: Hostel laundry facility limited to two hours
description: The hostel laundry facility is only available for two hours on Sunday. Given the number of residents this means most students never get access on a given week.

title: Hostel residents denied emergency exit route information
description: Hostel residents were not informed of the emergency exit routes during induction. When a student asked the warden they were told to refer to a notice that was never posted.

title: Students not allowed personal visitors in hostel
description: The hostel does not allow any personal visitors including parents to meet students within the hostel premises. Students must walk to the main gate for any meeting.

title: Bus permit not valid for new route
description: The college bus was rerouted to a new road that is not covered under the existing vehicle permit. The bus may be operating illegally on this section of the route.

title: No safety audit for college vehicles
description: No safety or fitness audit has been conducted for any of the college bus fleet this academic year. Several buses have visible mechanical wear and maintenance issues.

title: Bus conductor collecting unauthorised fees
description: The bus conductor has been collecting an informal monthly charge from students claiming it is for additional services. No official communication supports this collection.

title: Student fell due to sudden braking
description: A student fell and was injured when the bus driver braked suddenly at high speed without warning. No incident report was filed and the injured student received no assistance.

title: Bus not covered by valid insurance
description: A student observed that the insurance document displayed on the college bus has expired. This means students travelling are not covered in case of an accident.

title: Unverified driver operating college bus
description: The college bus on Route 9 is being driven by a person who is not the registered driver. Students do not recognise the driver and the transport office cannot confirm their identity.

title: Bus used for private hire on weekdays
description: The college bus assigned to Route 5 has been absent from its route on multiple mornings. Students later saw it being used for a private school pickup service.

title: No bus for special needs student
description: A student with a mobility impairment who requires front-seat accessible transport is not accommodated by any of the current buses.

title: Late bus causing examination absence
description: A student arrived late for an examination because the college bus was delayed by 50 minutes. The student was denied entry and recorded as absent for the paper.

title: Bus route app showing wrong location
description: The college mobile app showing real-time bus location is consistently showing the wrong bus position. Students plan their commute around this data and are missing the bus as a result.

title: Library fine system not transparent
description: The library fine calculation is not documented. Students receive unexpected fine amounts with no breakdown of how the amount was calculated.

title: Thesis binding rejected twice
description: My thesis was rejected by the library for binding format twice despite following the guidelines I was given. The guidelines themselves appear to be inconsistent.

title: Library catalogue search not working
description: The online library catalogue search function has not been working for two weeks. Students cannot search for book availability and must manually check each shelf.

title: Faculty booking reading room for class
description: Faculty members are booking the library reading room for small group teaching sessions effectively displacing individual students who use it for studying.

title: No e-reader lending facility
description: The library has no e-reader or tablet lending facility. Students who need to access large volumes of digital content but lack devices have no institutional support.

title: Library hours not accommodating prayer times
description: The library schedule does not accommodate daily prayer times. Students with religious observance requirements cannot use the library during certain periods without missing prayers.

title: Old password still required for e-resources
description: The login credentials for subscribed e-resources were not updated when the system was renewed. Students are locked out because they are using credentials that no longer work.

title: No mechanism to request new book purchases
description: There is no formal mechanism for students to request books to be purchased by the library. Student research needs are never fed into the acquisition process.

title: Library not accepting books for donation
description: A batch of graduating students tried to donate their textbooks to the library before leaving. The library refused to accept them despite having no copies of those titles.

title: Head librarian unresponsive to student requests
description: The head librarian has not responded to formal written requests from multiple students about access issues and policy clarifications for over six weeks.

title: Lab report not accepted due to font issue
description: A student's laboratory report was rejected because the font size did not exactly match an unwritten unofficial standard. No such format requirement exists in any published document.

title: Lab computer virus affecting student work
description: A computer virus in the computer science lab has corrupted student project files saved on lab computers. The virus was known to IT staff but no action was taken for two weeks.

title: No lockable storage for personal items in lab
description: The laboratory has no secure storage for students to leave personal belongings while conducting experiments. Items left on tables have been misplaced or stolen.

title: Equipment malfunction mid-experiment not logged
description: When equipment malfunctioned during a practical session the instructor asked students to estimate values rather than repeat the experiment. The malfunction was not logged.

title: Students not informed about chemical allergies
description: Students were not asked about chemical allergies before being assigned to chemistry laboratory experiments. A student had a mild allergic reaction to a reagent used in an experiment.

title: Practical cancelled on exam day without notice
description: The practical examination for Physics was cancelled on the day it was scheduled with no explanation. Students who had prepared found out only upon arriving at the laboratory.

title: Lab internet blocked during research project
description: The internet connection in the research computing laboratory was blocked during a critical phase of student thesis work. IT helpdesk confirmed no maintenance was scheduled.

title: No protective screen for laser equipment
description: Students working with low-power laser equipment in the optics laboratory are not provided with protective eyewear. International safety standards require protection even for low-power lasers.

title: Sample contaminated in biology practical
description: A practical examination sample was contaminated in the biology laboratory. Students who unknowingly worked with the contaminated sample recorded incorrect results affecting their marks.

title: Lab supervisor absent for entire semester
description: The designated supervisor for the mechatronics laboratory has been absent for the entire semester with no replacement. Students have been conducting sessions entirely unsupervised.

title: Health centre only open during class hours
description: The campus health centre is only open during class hours on weekdays. Students who fall ill in the evening on weekends or during holidays have no on-campus medical support.

title: No provision for student governance feedback
description: The student governance body has no mechanism to formally submit feedback to the college administration. All feedback must be routed through individual faculty contacts.

title: NSS credits not recorded
description: I have completed the mandatory NSS hours for two academic years. The NSS coordinator has not updated the portal to reflect my service hours which are required for my degree.

title: Fire safety certificate expired
description: The fire safety certificate for the main academic block expired six months ago and has not been renewed. This is a regulatory non-compliance that affects the safety of all occupants.

title: Students fined for natural hair styles
description: Students with natural hair styles that do not comply with an informal dress code are being asked to modify their appearance. No formal policy supports this requirement.

title: Events scheduled during Eid and Diwali
description: Major examinations and mandatory college events have been scheduled on religious festivals celebrated by significant portions of the student body without accommodation.

title: Student achievements not mentioned in annual report
description: Student achievements including national-level awards research publications and sports achievements were not mentioned in the college annual report despite being officially submitted.

title: No structured project exhibition
description: The college has no annual technical or research project exhibition. Students with impressive projects have no institutional platform to showcase their work.

title: Campus safety escort service not available
description: A safety escort service for students returning to hostels at night was promised in the college safety policy but has never been made operational.

title: No transparency in examination result moderation
description: The examination result moderation process is completely opaque. Students do not know how moderation decisions are made or whether their papers were reviewed fairly.

title: Mid-semester marks not uploaded on portal
description: The mid-semester examination marks are not uploaded on the student portal after two months. Students cannot track their academic progress or plan effectively.

title: Professor frequently late to class
description: The professor for the Thermodynamics course consistently arrives 15 to 20 minutes late to every lecture. Over the semester this has resulted in over 10 hours of lost teaching time.

title: Dissertation word limit not communicated
description: The word limit for the dissertation was communicated verbally but not in writing. Different students were given different figures and the examination section is now imposing a strict cut-off.

title: Workshop credits not counted for CGPA
description: The credits for the mandatory workshop completed last year have not been added to my CGPA calculation. This affects my scholarship eligibility and rank.

title: Elective course withdrawn after student selection
description: The elective course I selected during registration was withdrawn from the offering two weeks into the semester. I was assigned a compulsory course I had not chosen without any prior discussion.

title: Course content not explained in English
description: A core subject is being explained entirely in a regional language in one section. Students who do not speak the language cannot follow the lectures.

title: Student failing due to unmarked submission
description: A student who submitted all required coursework is failing because the submissions were never marked and entered into the system. No grade exists for them for three assignments.

title: Annual report grade higher than actual
description: The grade displayed in the college annual report for the student section is higher than the actual grade as maintained in the academic records office.

title: Assessment format changed last minute
description: The format of the end-semester examination was changed from essay-based to objective-based two days before the examination. Students had prepared for a completely different format.

title: Practical marks deducted for late submission
description: Practical records submitted one day late due to a medical emergency were given zero without considering the medical certificate provided.

title: Air conditioning causing illness
description: The air conditioning units in classroom 201 are blowing air with a mouldy smell. Three students have developed allergic reactions. The units have not been serviced in over a year.

title: Water fountain not cleaned
description: The drinking water fountain in the main corridor has visible green growth on the interior and has not been cleaned in months. Students are forced to drink potentially contaminated water.

title: Building expansion blocking natural light
description: The new building constructed adjacent to the main academic block is blocking natural light from entering classrooms on the east side entirely. This was foreseeable and not mitigated.

title: Lab building entrance obstructed
description: The main entrance to the laboratory building is regularly obstructed by parked vehicles belonging to administrative staff. Students and faculty with mobility issues cannot access it easily.

title: Dusty study environment causing health issues
description: The classrooms in the old wing have not been properly dusted or cleaned in months. Students with respiratory conditions are having recurring health issues related to the dusty environment.

title: No secure cycle parking
description: The college has no secure cycle parking area. Student bicycles are regularly stolen or vandalised from the open parking area. The college takes no responsibility.

title: Electrical panel unlocked in student area
description: An electrical panel in the student common area corridor is unlocked and accessible to anyone. Students with no electrical knowledge could accidentally touch live components.

title: Overhead tanks low making water quality poor
description: The overhead water tanks serving the academic block are too small and frequently run low. When tanks are low the water pressure drops and sediment from the tank bottom enters the supply.

title: Pedestrian walkway flooded regularly
description: The main pedestrian walkway connecting hostels to the academic block floods every time it rains due to poor drainage. Students wade through water or take a long detour.

title: College gate auto-lock malfunctioning
description: The automatic gate at the college entrance malfunctions frequently locking in the closed position and blocking entry and exit for up to 30 minutes.

title: Professor using fake credentials
description: A professor teaching an advanced subject has credentials that students discovered are from an institution that does not offer the claimed degree programme.

title: Systematic grade lowering before placement season
description: Every year just before the on-campus placement season several students' internal marks are lowered resulting in their CGPA falling below the shortlisting threshold.

title: Entire class failed in one subject
description: All sixty students in one section failed a particular subject while pass rates in all other subjects and sections were normal. The question paper and marking have not been reviewed.

title: Student union elections rigged
description: The recently held student union elections were allegedly rigged in favour of students connected to the management. Independent candidates were denied fair campaign opportunities.

title: College denying NAAC accreditation access
description: The college is preventing the NAAC peer team from meeting students directly during an accreditation visit. Student feedback is being filtered through administrative staff.

title: Examination results withheld for fee default
description: The examination results of over a hundred students have been withheld citing pending dues. Many students have already paid but the accounts system has not updated.

title: Mass shortage declared without verification
description: Attendance shortage has been declared for an entire batch without individual verification. Over 30 students who attended all classes are included in the shortage list.

title: Faculty threatening to fail entire class
description: A professor openly threatened to fail the entire class if anyone reported the incomplete syllabus to the department head. This is documented in screenshots.

title: College misrepresenting approval status
description: The college is enrolling students in programmes that have not received regulatory approval. Students are at risk of receiving degrees that are not valid.

title: Research lab data stolen
description: Data from the campus research laboratory including unpublished results was accessed and shared externally. Three students thesis work may have been compromised.

title: Anonymous test submission
description: This submission is intentionally blank to test the system.

title: Duplicate of hostel food complaint
description: Hostel mess food is repeatedly of poor quality and students are getting sick. This is the same issue I reported last month.

title: Repeat bus complaint same issue
description: College bus route 4 still consistently late. Filed same complaint in week 2 and week 4. No action taken.

title: Duplicate library fine issue
description: Still being charged incorrectly for the books I returned on time. Same as my complaint filed three weeks ago.

title: Same lab safety issue unresolved
description: No safety equipment in electronics lab. This is the same issue raised two months ago and still unresolved.

title: Nothing happened to my grievance
description: I filed a complaint about a harassing professor but nothing was done and the situation is now worse.

title: Fee complaint duplicate
description: Still charged twice for examination fee. Original complaint from last semester.

title: Admin still not issuing certificate
description: I filed a complaint two months ago about my degree certificate not being issued. Still not resolved.

title: Same ragging issue continuing
description: The ragging by seniors I reported has not stopped. The anti-ragging committee did nothing and the behaviour continues.

title: Infrastructure complaint repeat
description: The broken projector in room 204 which I reported six weeks ago has still not been repaired.

title: Short submission test
description: Issue.

title: Spam complaint
description: Buy cheap medicines online call now.

title: Random text complaint
description: asdfghjkl this is not a real complaint just testing.

title: Gibberish submission
description: aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa bbbbbbbbbb

title: Empty complaint with only title
description: Professor was rude.

title: Highly exaggerated complaint
description: Every professor at this college is completely incompetent. Every course is taught wrong. Every facility is broken. The entire institution is fraudulent and should be shut down.

title: Vague untestable allegation
description: Someone is doing something bad to students somewhere in the college building but I cannot say who what or where.

title: Complaint with external links
description: My complaint is documented here: http://externalsite.com/complaint please visit for details.

title: Repetition of same word
description: Unfair unfair unfair unfair unfair unfair unfair everything is unfair.

title: Complaint in all capitals
description: THE PROFESSOR FAILED ME FOR NO REASON THE MARKS ARE WRONG GIVE ME MY MARKS BACK NOW.

title: Professor not returning calls
description: My project supervisor has not responded to three weeks of emails and calls. Final submission is approaching and I have no feedback on my work.

title: Library access card lost by staff
description: My library access card was handed to staff for renewal. After three weeks it has not been returned and the staff deny having received it.

title: Exam scheduled on cultural festival
description: The end-semester examination is scheduled on the day of the regional cultural festival which is an official state holiday. Students from that region must skip religious observance.

title: Timetable conflict for elective
description: My elective course timetable conflicts with a core course. When this was raised the administration said one course must be dropped but both are compulsory.

title: Hostel furniture not pest resistant
description: The wooden hostel furniture is heavily infested with woodworm and termites. Several tables and chairs have collapsed and the college has not arranged replacements.

title: Wi-Fi password not shared with new students
description: New students joining midway through the semester were not given the campus Wi-Fi credentials. They have been paying for mobile data to attend online sessions for six weeks.

title: Student falsely accused of assault
description: A student has been falsely accused of physically assaulting another student. The accusation is not supported by CCTV footage or witness statements that are available.

title: No compensation for cancelled internship
description: The college placement cell cancelled a confirmed internship arrangement at the last minute. The student had declined other offers. No alternate placement or compensation was provided.

title: Examination paper ran out during exam
description: The printed examination papers ran out during a batch examination. The last fifteen students to receive papers were given photocopied versions that were illegible in places.

title: Professor using student as teaching assistant without pay
description: A student is being asked to conduct tutorial sessions and grade assignments without being paid or officially appointed as a teaching assistant.

title: Mess serving non-freshly cooked food
description: The hostel mess is serving food that was clearly cooked the previous day and reheated. Students have confirmed this by the texture and temperature of the food served.

title: Lab server down during project submission
description: The college lab server on which students are required to submit final project files was down on the last day of submission. No extension was granted.

title: Student excluded from team due to gender
description: A female student was excluded from a competitive technical team by peer group members who stated they did not want female team members for a male-dominated competition.

title: Mess fees increasing every semester
description: The hostel mess fee has increased every semester without any explanation. Over four semesters the fee has nearly doubled with no corresponding improvement in quality.

title: Transport coordinator unreachable
description: The college transport coordinator has been unreachable by phone or email for three weeks. Students with urgent transport issues have no point of contact.

title: Plumbing failure flooding laboratory
description: A plumbing failure flooded the ground floor of the science laboratory block during active hours. Equipment and student belongings were damaged.

title: Lab hazard not cleaned after spill
description: A chemical spill in the biology laboratory was not cleaned properly. Students in the next session worked in a contaminated space.

title: Professor threatening student with expulsion
description: A professor told a student that they would ensure the student is expelled for asking a question about exam marks in front of the class.

title: Graduation requirement unclear
description: Students in the final year are receiving conflicting information about the number of credits required for graduation. The published guideline contradicts what the examination section says.

title: Security staff harassing student near gate
description: A security guard near the main gate has been making rude and intrusive comments to a student every time they enter or exit the campus.

title: Practical batch not rotated fairly
description: The practical laboratory batches were formed based on alphabetical order and have never been rotated. Students with surnames at the end of the alphabet always get the last session with tired instructors.

title: Sports certificate not signed
description: I won a district-level sports event and submitted the certificate for CGPA bonus marks. After four months the certificate has not been processed or returned.

title: College ID card expiry not communicated
description: My college ID card expired without any notification. I was denied entry to the examination hall because the card was expired. No renewal reminder was sent.

title: Two professors giving conflicting instructions
description: Two faculty members teaching the same course in different sections gave conflicting instructions about the format for the term project. Students followed one and were penalised.

title: Printing quota not reset at start of semester
description: The printing quota from last semester was not reset at the start of the new semester. Students who exhausted their quota early last year have no prints available this semester.

title: Student council funds misappropriated
description: The student council collected event participation fees from all students. The event was cancelled and the funds were not refunded. The council treasurer is not responding to queries.

title: No washroom near sports ground
description: There is no washroom facility near the sports ground. Students playing outdoor sports must walk to the main building which is five minutes away.

title: Faculty office hours not honoured
description: Professors publish office hours but are consistently not available during those times. Students who travel to the campus specifically for office hour meetings are regularly turned away.

title: Cultural events not inclusive
description: Cultural events organised by the college celebrate only festivals from one region. Students from other states and communities feel their cultures are not represented or respected.

title: No space for project team collaboration
description: There is no dedicated space on campus for project teams to collaborate. Teams working on final year projects with hardware components have nowhere to set up and work together.

title: Hostel kitchen used by staff for personal cooking
description: The hostel kitchen is being used by staff members for personal meal preparation. This reduces access for students during permissible cooking hours and raises hygiene concerns.

title: Library fine charged to wrong student ID
description: The fine for a book I borrowed was charged to a different student's account due to a data entry error. That student is now facing access restrictions they did not cause.

title: Research lab always locked
description: The open research laboratory which should be accessible to all registered project students during college hours is consistently locked with no explanation or key access procedure.

title: Bus window broken creating safety risk
description: A window in Bus Route 3 is broken. During rain water enters through the gap and during summer the sharp edge is at arm height. Students have minor cuts. The issue has been reported.

title: Library assistant sleeping during duty hours
description: Students in the library have observed the on-duty library assistant sleeping at the desk during operational hours. Students needing help receive none.

title: Grievance to warden ignored for a month
description: A formal written grievance submitted to the hostel warden one month ago has received no response. The warden denies receiving it though two witnesses were present at submission.

title: Student union printing resources misused
description: The student union printing resources reserved for academic use are being regularly used by a small group for personal purposes leaving nothing for legitimate student needs.

title: Female students asked to leave campus early
description: Female students are being informally asked to leave campus earlier than their male counterparts despite having the same timetable. No policy supports this different treatment.

title: No action on POSH Act complaint
description: A student filed a formal complaint under the POSH Act eight weeks ago. No acknowledgment of receipt was provided and no inquiry committee has been constituted.

title: Admin withholding result for political reasons
description: A student active in student rights advocacy has had their result withheld without any stated academic reason. Other students with identical records were not affected.

title: Practical experiment unsafe without documentation
description: Students are conducting experiments with reactive metals in water without any documented safety protocol. The experiment has not been reviewed by a safety officer.

title: Semester break shortened without notice
description: The semester break was shortened by two weeks without any advance notice. Students who had made travel and personal plans could not return in time and were marked absent.

title: Student asked to remove social media post
description: A student was called by the administration and asked to remove a social media post describing their experience on campus. The post did not contain any false information.

title: College blocking student email domain
description: Emails sent to the college from personal Gmail or Yahoo accounts are being automatically filtered and not delivered. Students with critical issues cannot communicate electronically.

title: Lab practical cancelled on semester last day
description: The final practical session of the semester was cancelled on the same day without prior notice. Students who had scheduled their final experiment had to leave without completing it.

title: Hostel access card blocked without explanation
description: My hostel access card stopped working without any notification. I was locked out for an entire evening and had to sleep in the common room.

title: Faculty penalising students asking for notes
description: A professor is penalising students who ask for written notes by reducing their participation marks. The professor insists students only learn by listening in class.

title: Water heater in hostel causing shocks
description: The water heater in the hostel bathroom gives electric shocks when touched. Three students reported this and it has been two weeks with no repair.

title: Bus passes issued without photo
description: Bus passes are being issued without student photographs. Any person could use the pass and access the college bus. This is a security and accountability concern.

title: Library access blocked during internship
description: Students on campus-approved internships who need library access for their project work are unable to access the library because their status is listed as on-leave.

title: Canteen selling expired snacks
description: The college canteen was found selling packaged snacks with expired best-before dates. When students pointed this out the canteen staff removed them temporarily but restocked them the next day.

title: Lab instructor refusing to demonstrate
description: The laboratory instructor refuses to demonstrate experiments before asking students to perform them citing time constraints. Students perform critical experiments without first seeing them done.

title: Fee receipt destroyed by administration
description: The original fee receipt I submitted along with my scholarship application was not returned and the scholarship office claims the file was lost during a relocation.

title: Campus night security non-existent
description: After 10 PM there is no security presence on the main campus. Incidents of theft vandalism and trespassing have increased as a result.

title: Student research published without attribution
description: A research paper submitted by a student as part of course assessment was submitted to a journal by the professor under the professor's name without the student's knowledge.

title: Duplicate lab submission rejected
description: I submitted my lab records twice after the first was lost. The second submission is being rejected as a re-submission beyond deadline even though the first was lost by the department.

title: Medical room inaccessible during exam
description: During the examination period the campus medical room was closed for renovation. Students who fell ill during exams had no access to on-campus medical care.

title: Tutor absent during critical revision period
description: The assigned tutorial class tutor was absent for three weeks during the most critical examination revision period. No replacement was arranged.

title: Hostel application status unknown for months
description: I applied for hostel accommodation three months ago. I have received no acknowledgment no status update and no decision. The hostel office is unable to locate my application.

title: Lab data backup lost
description: The backup of laboratory data from the semester was lost due to a storage failure. Students whose projects relied on this data have no way to recover their work.

title: Professor accepting late work for favourites
description: The professor does not accept late submissions as per policy. However certain students known personally to the professor are allowed to submit days late without penalty.

title: Student welfare committee not active
description: The student welfare committee has not held a single meeting in two semesters. Issues reported through this channel simply accumulate with no discussion or resolution.

title: Certificate verification rejected due to admin error
description: An employer conducting background verification of my degree was told by the college verification team that my degree is not on record due to a data entry error.

title: No protocol for student suicide prevention
description: A student attempted self-harm on campus and the staff had no protocol or training to respond. The incident was handled poorly and the student received no follow-up mental health support.

title: Exam absent but marked as present
description: A student who was genuinely absent for a legitimate reason was marked as present in an examination. This creates complications when the student applies for a supplementary exam.

title: Lab chemicals disposed in general waste
description: Chemistry laboratory chemicals are being disposed of in the general campus waste. This poses environmental and health risks and violates chemical disposal regulations.

title: Course completion not reflected in records
description: I completed an additional certification course offered by the college. The completion is not reflected in my official academic records despite submitting the required documentation.

title: Attendance register shown as blank for entire semester
description: My attendance register for one subject appears blank for the entire semester despite attending all classes. This could result in being barred from the examination.

title: Professor's relative given project priority
description: Students noticed that a student who is the professor's relative consistently receives priority for project resources space and supervisor time over other students.

title: Student not allowed to graduate due to fee error
description: A student was not allowed to participate in the graduation ceremony due to an outstanding dues notice. The student paid all fees and has receipts but the portal was not updated.

title: Wi-Fi blocked during online examination
description: The campus Wi-Fi was completely non-functional during a scheduled online examination. No alternative was provided and the exam was not rescheduled.

title: Faculty ignoring accessibility requirements
description: A student with a visual impairment requested large-print examination papers. The request was ignored and no accommodation was provided on the day of the exam.

title: Thesis rejected without formal evaluation
description: A student's final year thesis was rejected without going through the formal evaluation process. No written reason was provided and no appeal mechanism was communicated.

title: Emergency contact not updated in system
description: A student updated their emergency contact details but the system was not updated. During a medical emergency the college contacted a number that was no longer active.

title: Lab practical based on theory not communicated
description: The lab practical examination tested theoretical knowledge rather than hands-on skills. No communication was given in advance about this change in examination format.

title: Professor sharing exam answers with preferred students
description: There is strong evidence that a professor shared answers to the practical examination with a small group of students before the examination was conducted.

title: Scholarship selection rigged
description: The college-funded internal scholarship was awarded to students with lower academic scores who have personal connections with the selection committee members.

title: Students exposed to asbestos
description: Renovation work on the old building disturbed ceiling tiles later identified as containing asbestos. Students nearby during the work were not warned or evacuated.

title: Child labour used in college canteen
description: A child below the age of 14 was observed working in the college canteen. This is a violation of child labour laws that has been reported to the administration.

title: Exam form rejection with no appeal
description: My examination form was rejected citing an incomplete field. The rejection was communicated one day before the examination deadline leaving no time for correction or appeal.

title: Exam result missing from university records
description: My end-semester examination result is missing from the university database. The college submitted results for all students but the university shows no record for my roll number.

title: Laboratory equipment used for commercial purpose
description: College-owned laboratory equipment is being rented to external clients by a faculty member for commercial purposes. Students cannot access the equipment during these rentals.

title: Fake NOC given to regulatory body
description: The college has issued a fake No Objection Certificate to an external training institute representing approval that was never granted. Students enrolled in that institute are at risk.

title: Student beaten by senior student on campus
description: A first-year student was physically assaulted by a senior student inside the campus. The incident was witnessed by security but no police report has been filed.

title: Practical marks given before exam conducted
description: Laboratory practical marks for the semester were uploaded to the university portal before the practical examination had been conducted.

title: Faculty collecting fees for notes
description: A professor is collecting money from students in exchange for printed study notes claiming they are self-published but charging above cost to personal benefit.

title: Anonymous threat of violence on campus
description: An anonymous note threatening violence against a group of students was found in the college notice board area. The note was photographed by students and reported to the warden.

title: Scholarship amount not matching government schedule
description: The scholarship disbursed to eligible students is lower than the government-prescribed amount by 20 percent. The college accounts office is not able to explain the shortfall.

title: College misrepresenting affiliation status
description: The college is claiming affiliation with a reputed university on its website and brochure. The stated affiliation was terminated two years ago and has not been renewed.

title: Student data shared with foreign entity
description: Student academic and personal data appears to have been shared with a foreign entity as part of an unauthorised data sharing arrangement. Students were not informed or consented.

title: Professor not available before exam
description: My professor is not available during office hours to clarify doubts before the final examination. I have been trying to reach them for a week with no response.

title: Mess serving undercooked chicken
description: The hostel mess served visibly undercooked chicken. Multiple students raised the concern immediately. No corrective action was taken for that meal service.

title: Bus conductor drunk on duty
description: A student reported that the bus conductor on Route 2 appeared to be intoxicated while on duty. The incident was observed by multiple students during the morning journey.

title: Lab practical schedule not matching timetable
description: The laboratory practical sessions are happening on different days than what is published in the official timetable. Students planning their week according to the published timetable miss sessions.

title: Campus map not updated after new construction
description: The campus map available at the entrance and on the website has not been updated to show new buildings and relocated facilities. Students and visitors are regularly getting lost.

title: Student threatened for competitive success
description: A student who topped the department examination received threatening messages from peers who accused the student of bribing the professor for marks.

title: Library data entry error causing fine
description: Due to a data entry error my library record shows that I borrowed a book I never received. A fine is being charged for this non-borrowed book.

title: Lab experiments not completing in allocated time
description: The time allocated for each laboratory experiment is insufficient. Students regularly cannot complete experiments within the session and are not given extension time.

title: College app not working for fee payment
description: The college mobile app used for online fee payments has been crashing during transaction completion. Fees are being debited but not recorded and students are receiving error messages.

title: New hostel block under construction during occupancy
description: Students are living in a hostel block adjacent to active construction. Dust noise and safety risks from the construction site are affecting daily life and study.

title: No protocol for hostel fire emergency
description: During a false fire alarm in the hostel students did not know what to do. The warden was absent and no one had information about the muster point or evacuation route.

title: Fraudulent student enrolled in exam
description: Evidence suggests a non-enrolled individual appeared in the semester examination using a student's identity. The invigilator did not verify IDs systematically.

title: Principal promising but never delivering
description: The principal has made the same commitments about improving campus Wi-Fi library hours and health services for three consecutive years without any of these being fulfilled.

title: Library printer used by staff for personal purposes
description: The library printer reserved for student use is being used by staff for official and personal printing leaving students with no printing resource.

title: Substitute teacher not teaching syllabus
description: The substitute faculty member covering for an absent professor is teaching entirely different content unrelated to the course syllabus.

title: Complaint box never opened
description: The physical complaint box installed near the administrative office has never been opened or cleared as far as any student can observe. Its existence appears to be performative.

title: Students discouraged from filing grievances
description: The class coordinator actively discourages students from filing formal grievances saying it will hurt their academic standing and create problems during placement season.

title: Canteen hygiene inspection not conducted
description: The canteen has not undergone any hygiene or food safety inspection this academic year despite this being a regulatory requirement for campus food services.

title: Lab equipment allocated before student access
description: Laboratory equipment needed for projects is being allocated to research scholars before undergraduate students even when the projects are of equal academic priority.

title: Student barred from examination without formal notice
description: A student was prevented from entering the examination hall by the invigilator citing an alleged documentation issue. No formal barring notice had been issued previously.

title: HOD approving requests selectively
description: The Head of Department approves requests for leave additional resources and recommendations for students they know personally while declining the same requests from others.

title: College delaying response to legal notice
description: The college received a legal notice from a student's guardian regarding academic rights violations. The institution has not responded within the prescribed period.

title: Student result held as institutional leverage
description: A graduating student's result is being unofficially withheld by the administration as leverage to prevent the student from reporting an institutional violation to the regulator.

title: Lab chemical misidentified causing wrong experiment
description: A chemical in the laboratory was stored in the wrong container with an incorrect label. Students conducted an entire experiment using the wrong reagent and the results were submitted.

title: Bus driver threatening students
description: The driver of Bus Route 1 made verbal threats to two students who complained about his driving behaviour. The students are afraid to board the bus but need transport to college.

title: Hostel staff photographing students without consent
description: Hostel staff have been observed photographing female students in the common area on personal mobile phones. No consent was sought and the purpose is unknown.

title: College withholding transcripts for fee dispute
description: Transcripts required for higher education applications are being withheld by the college citing a fee dispute that the student has already resolved with documented proof.

title: Student internship blocked by college
description: The college administration is blocking a student from joining a confirmed internship at a top company citing a rule that internships must be sourced through the placement cell only.

title: Mental health crisis not handled properly
description: A student experiencing a mental health crisis on campus was not given appropriate support. Staff called the student's parents without the student's consent and did not arrange professional help.

title: Complete institutional failure in grievance resolution
description: A student who filed twelve formal grievances over two semesters through every available channel received no resolution on any issue. The student is now preparing a legal complaint.
